item.title: Trump écarte la nouvelle porte-parole de la Maison Blanche
item.description: La porte-parole de la Maison Blanche, Katie Zacharia, a été "démise de ses fonctions", a déclaré vendredi un responsable de la Maison Blanche, après que le président Donald Trump a déclaré qu'il lui avait demandé d'envisager de démissionner.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward, Nandita Bose
item.content:encoded: La porte-parole de la Maison Blanche, Katie Zacharia, a été "démise de ses fonctions", a déclaré vendredi un responsable de la Maison Blanche, après que le président Donald Trump a déclaré qu'il lui avait demandé d'envisager de démissionner. "Je lui ai dit : 'Je pense que tu as tout intérêt à être heureuse, et je ne suis pas sûr que tu puisses un jour être heureuse dans ce milieu.'", a déclaré Donald Trump à la presse alors qu’il quittait la Maison Blanche. Le président américain a ajouté : "Je lui ai dit en toute honnêteté : 'Si j’étais toi, je réfléchirais à deux fois... Réfléchis-y. Mais je réfléchirais à deux fois.'" Après la confirmation de la mise à l'écart de Katie Zacharia, Donald Trump a déclaré à Fox News qu'il n'était pas pressé de nommer un nouveau porte-parole. Katie Zacharia avait pris ses fonctions lundi, en remplacement de Karoline Leavitt, et a tenu son premier point presse à la Maison Blanche mardi. La nouvelle porte-parole, qui se présentait comme avocate, a aussitôt été au coeur au sujet de cette fonction. Elle a finalement reconnu dans une interview accordée à Fox News qu’elle n’avait pas réussi l’examen du barreau.

item.title: ANÁLISIS Por qué CoreWeave se convirtió en el centro de la alarma por la IA
item.description: La empresa estadounidense de servicios en la nube CoreWeave , deficitaria y profundamente endeudada, se convirtió esta semana en un blanco fácil para los inversionistas preocupados por una posible burbuja de la inteligencia artificial (IA). Sin embargo, su desplome tiene una importancia mayor para los mercados de lo que su tamaño podría sugerir.
item.dc:creator: Vidya Ranganathan, Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: La empresa estadounidense de servicios en la nube CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , deficitaria y profundamente endeudada, se convirtió esta semana en un blanco fácil para los inversionistas preocupados por una posible burbuja de la inteligencia artificial (IA). Sin embargo, su desplome tiene una importancia mayor para los mercados de lo que su tamaño podría sugerir. La caída de las acciones y los bonos de esta empresa de infraestructura de IA, respaldada por Nvidia (NVDA.O) y valorada en 39.000 millones de dólares, ocurrió después de que los reportes del tercer trimestre de los hiperescaladores apuntaron a retrasos en los proyectos de centros de datos y a un ritmo más lento de crecimiento del gasto de capital. Inversionistas preocupados pusieron la mira en las empresas de nube de nueva generación basadas en IA, o "neoclouds", como CoreWeave, posiblemente los eslabones más débiles del ecosistema debido a que recurren a un fuerte endeudamiento para financiar chips, terrenos y energía para centros de datos que solo generarán ingresos en el futuro. Las acciones de CoreWeave se desplomaron más de un 15% esta semana, mientras que los rendimientos de sus bonos con vencimiento en 2030 se dispararon 500 puntos básicos, a cerca del 16%. El presidente ejecutivo de CoreWeave, Mike Intrator, explicó a los empleados en un memorándum al que tuvo acceso Reuters que los mercados a veces pueden "malinterpretar y actuar de forma irracional" y que la empresa cuenta con una sólida cartera de pedidos. La compañía no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios de Reuters. Los inversionistas se centraron, en cambio, en su deuda de 50.000 millones de dólares y en los riesgos de quedar atrapada en el centro de un circuito de financiación entre fabricantes de chips como Nvidia y clientes como Meta Platforms (META.O) y OpenAI. "El problema con todo esto es que estamos hablando de una enorme interconexión, no solo de financiación circular, sino del hecho de que todos estos activos están en manos de los mismos inversionistas, en los mismos lugares y en las mismas carteras", dijo James Athey, gestor de carteras de renta fija en Marlborough. "Y el apalancamiento es siempre el factor que convierte lo que podría ser una tormenta en un vaso de agua en algo mucho más nefasto", añadió, refiriéndose en términos generales al nerviosismo por las inversiones en IA. Empresas como CoreWeave, Nebius (NBIS.O) , Applied Digital (APLD.O) , Iren (IREN.O) , Lambda Labs, Crusoe y TeraWulf (WULF.O) están construyendo centros de datos que consumen mucha energía y que, con el tiempo, podrán alquilar a empresas que desarrollen y usen modelos de IA. Esto requiere una inversión inicial enorme y genera muy pocos ingresos hasta que comiencen los contratos de alquiler. Según los datos recopilados por LSEG, CoreWeave nunca ha obtenido ganancias. El presidente ejecutivo de CoreWeave también señaló en el memorándum que su cartera de pedidos cubre con creces sus obligaciones de deuda. La empresa contaba con una cartera de ingresos de 104.200 millones de dólares al final del segundo trimestre, a lo que se sumaron más de 25.000 millones de dólares en nuevos compromisos a principios del tercer trimestre. Sin embargo, la empresa de Nueva Jersey está gastando efectivo más rápido de lo que les gustaría a los inversionistas. En 2025, CoreWeave tuvo unos ingresos anuales de 5.100 millones de dólares y unas pérdidas netas de 1.200 millones de dólares. Aunque se espera que los ingresos se dupliquen este año, se estima que el gasto de capital se multiplicará por cuatro, situándose entre 35.000 millones y 39.000 millones de dólares, lo que provocará un mayor consumo de efectivo. No ha ayudado la noticia de que Intrator y las entidades vinculadas a él hayan vendido acciones por valor de casi 1.000 millones de dólares desde la salida a bolsa de la empresa en marzo del año pasado, en su mayoría en el marco de planes de negociación preacordados, según los documentos presentados ante las autoridades reguladoras. "Es evidente que necesitarán una inyección de capital o un rescate. Están quemando capital, y el capital ya no es gratis", dijo Alberto Gallo, fundador del fondo de cobertura Andromeda Capital. "Normalmente como inversionista en bonos lo que se busca es comprar deuda de empresas que tengan un flujo de caja visible, no de alguien que esté realizando inversiones en activos fijos, con la esperanza de que se necesiten más inversiones de este tipo en el futuro", añadió. La firma mantiene posiciones en contra de los bonos de CoreWeave. MUCHAS DUDAS CoreWeave encabeza la lista de las aproximadamente 100 empresas de "neocloud" que, según la consultora Gartner Inc., son "las más expuestas al desequilibrio entre ingresos y gasto de capital" y necesitan obtener ganancias pronto para mantener sus operaciones. Gartner prevé que, para 2030, el 80% de los proveedores de "neocloud" cesarán sus operaciones independientes. "Nos encontramos en una situación en la que hay muchas expectativas en torno a los ingresos y al crecimiento de los mismos, pero este crecimiento se está alimentando con el tipo de capital equivocado, que es la deuda, no el capital propio", dijo Tommaso Leodari, director de inversiones del fondo de cobertura Index & Cie, de Dubái, que no tiene participaciones en empresas dedicadas exclusivamente a la IA. "En el caso concreto de CoreWeave, está financiando todo su negocio con deuda. Así que, si ocurre algo en la utilización de este activo en particular o si hay una ralentización en la construcción de estos centros de datos, ello se traducirá en problemas a la hora de reembolsar la deuda". Una serie de advertencias de gigantes de la IA como Oracle Corp (ORCL.N) y Microsoft (MSFT.O) sobre retrasos en los proyectos de centros de datos, cuellos de botella en el suministro eléctrico y de componentes, un exceso de oferta de chips de gama alta, junto con los planes de gigantes como Meta y Microsoft de lanzar sus propios chips para competir con los de Nvidia, han avivado las preocupaciones sobre los "neoclouds". El ritmo de crecimiento de los ingresos de gigantes de la IA como OpenAI y Anthropic, aunque sigue siendo rápido, también se ha moderado. "Incluso con unos ingresos de 10.000 millones de dólares, CoreWeave está registrando pérdidas de 2.500 millones, por lo que aún no se aprecian claramente efectos de escala en el sector", escribió Michael Frazis, de Frazis Capital Partners, de Sídney. CoreWeave cuenta con el respaldo de Nvidia. El gigante de los chips se ha comprometido a comprar la capacidad de cálculo no vendida de CoreWeave hasta abril de 2032, lo que garantiza que la empresa tendrá un comprador para la capacidad que no se venda a los clientes. Las agencias han calificado la deuda de CoreWeave como de grado especulativo. Sin embargo, Sean Cray, vicepresidente de Moody's Ratings, señaló que la empresa no compra chips de forma especulativa y cuenta con múltiples vías de financiación. Aunque en sus orígenes era una empresa dedicada a la minería de bitcóin, CoreWeave ha seguido siendo un blanco fácil para los especuladores, y los fondos de cobertura han estado comprando sus bonos con calificación de "basura" por su alto rendimiento. El costo de asegurar su deuda contra el impago se disparó esta semana hasta unos 1.200 puntos básicos, lo que indica graves dificultades. "La venta masiva de títulos de crédito de CoreWeave corre el riesgo de convertirse en una profecía autocumplida", escribió Saurav Sen, de la empresa de investigación Gimme Credit. "La preocupación no es tanto si los clientes quieren la capacidad, sino si CoreWeave puede permitirse ofrecerla".

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、ＦＲＢ金利据え置き観測強まる ＡＩ株安も重し
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、ＦＲＢ金利据え置き観測強まる　ＡＩ株安も重し 4:25 配信

２０１１年１月撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測の後退に加え、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄主導の株安への懸念が引き続き重しになっている。

米国では今週発表された９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）をが予想を上回って伸びたことなどで、一時的に利上げ観測が再燃。ただその後、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言で追加利上げを急がない姿勢が示されたことで、ドル相場に対する支援材料も薄れていた。

今週はこのほか、ＡＩ関連銘柄が大幅に下落。ＡＩ関連銘柄やサプライチェーン全体に資金を投じてきた投資家の間でデータセンター運営企業が債務返済に必要な利益を十分なタイミングで確保できるのか疑念が広がっていることが背景にあり、影響はドル相場にも波及している。

ストーンＸのグローバル市場調査責任者、マット・ウェラー氏は「今週、最も興味深いと感じたのはドル相場がＡＩ関連取引と極めて密接に連動したことだった」と指摘。「通常なら、ハイテク株が売られれば安全資産としてドルが買われる展開が予想される。実際、債券市場ではそうした安全資産買いの動きが一部見られたが、ドルはむしろ売られた」と述べた。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はバンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で行った講演で、米経済の力強さについて楽観的な見方を示すとともに、エネルギーショックが続きインフレ抑制に向けた金融引き締めが行われる中でも、世界経済が持ちこたえていることに驚きを表明。ＦＲＢの金融政策については「予断を持たない」と述べるにとどめ、追加利上げの可能性について手掛かりは示さなかった。

ＢＮＹ（ニューヨーク）の米州担当マクロストラテジスト、ジョン・ベリス氏は「２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げについて、ＦＯＭＣ内で特に理事の間で十分な支持があるとは思えない」と指摘。「１２月の次回会合については結論はまだ出ていない。それまでに多くのことが起こり得る」と述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、今月の会合で金利据え置きが決定される確率は８３％。１カ月前の４９％から大きく上昇した。

終盤の取引で、ドル／円は０．０８％安の１ドル＝１５８．１１円。日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。

ユーロ／ドルは０．０８％高の１．１２２７ドル。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％安の１０１．８７。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.99/158.04

始値 157.89

高値 158.33

安値 157.70

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1239/1.1240

始値 1.1258

高値 1.1261

安値 1.1213

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não disse em entrevista que irá cortar programas sociais
item.description: O candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) não afirmou em uma entrevista que, se eleito, cortará programas sociais. Publicações no Facebook com a alegação exibem um vídeo adulterado da conversa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: O candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) não afirmou em uma entrevista que, se eleito, cortará programas sociais. Publicações no Facebook com a alegação exibem um vídeo adulterado da conversa. Estes são os principais detalhes: Na gravação alterada, a jornalista Mariana Godoy, da Record, pergunta a Flávio: “Se o senhor for eleito, qual será a primeira medida que o senhor vai tomar?”. Flávio responde: “A gente tem que começar cortando os programas sociais, porque eu vou libertar o Brasil dessa chaga, desse câncer, dessa doença”. As imagens são de uma entrevista concedida pelo candidato ao programa Domingo Espetacular em agosto deste ano. No registro original , Flávio diz: “O que eu vou fazer é declarar Comando Vermelho, PCC e milícias como organizações terroristas”. Durante a conversa, ele não afirmou que fará cortes em programas sociais. Um site da campanha do candidato diz que seu plano de governo “prevê a manutenção de todos os programas sociais existentes”. Em nota , a campanha de Flávio disse que o candidato "não vai acabar com programas sociais, não vai mudar tempo de aposentadoria, fechar farmácias populares, nem extinguir o Bolsa Família." Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. Um vídeo de uma entrevista de Flávio foi manipulado para simular que ele disse que cortará programas sociais se eleito. (Texto atualizado em 16 de outubro de 2026 com resposta da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro.) Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Avenue Capital emerges as frontrunner for stake in Serie A media rights venture, sources say
item.description: Private equity firm Avenue Capital has emerged as the leading bidder for a minority stake in the company that will hold the international media rights of Italy's top soccer league Serie A, two people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Elvira Pollina
item.content:encoded: Private equity firm Avenue Capital has emerged as the leading bidder for a minority stake in the company that will hold the international media rights of Italy's top soccer league Serie A, two people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters. Serie A is exploring the sale of a stake in a company that will hold its international broadcasting, sponsorship and betting rights and last month it received final bids from private equity firms . Serie A clubs met on Friday for an initial review of the bids, the two people said. New York-based Avenue Capital is targeting a stake of 10% in the media company for €320 million, the people said, which would put the overall valuation of the venture at €3.2 billion. Avenue is in the lead despite the fact that some rival bidders have offered to pay more because its offer is structured as a common equity investment, without the protections on future cash flows sought by some of the competitors, one of the two people said. The person added that Carlyle and Nextalia, which teamed up to submit a joint bid, had offered around €650 million for a stake of roughly 17%, valuing the venture at about €3.75 billion. The Avenue Capital offer will be examined more closely in the coming weeks by the clubs, the people said, cautioning that there is no final decision on the matter. Avenue Capital and Serie A declined to comment. Carlyle and Nextalia were not immediately available to comment. Any deal requires the backing of at least 14 of the league's 20 clubs. Home to Inter Milan, AC Milan and Juventus (JUVE.MI) , the Italian league has been struggling in recent years to sell its media rights abroad, as broadcasters' interest dwindled due to a crowded fixture list dominated by the expanded UEFA Champions League and the popularity of England's Premier League. The Serie A international media unit generates sales of around €250 million a year, a fraction of those yielded by Premier League and Spain's LaLiga, according to data from European soccer body UEFA.

item.title: Nearly 12,000 California residents bought EVs using state rebate program
item.description: California said on Friday nearly 12,000 residents bought electric vehicles using rebates under a new $270 million program funded by the state and automakers.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: California said on Friday nearly 12,000 residents bought electric vehicles using rebates under a new $270 million program funded by the state and automakers. Still, overall EV sales have fallen both in California and nationwide as President Donald Trump's administration has removed federal incentives for EVs. EV sales are up globally. The program for California residents buying their first EV was signed into law by Governor Gavin Newsom in July and offers $3,500 rebates on new EVs with retail prices of up to $50,000 and a $1,750 rebate for used EVs costing no more than $25,000. California said EVs accounted for 18% of all state sales through September 30 compared to 23% last year and 25% in 2024. Tesla vehicles account for more than half of EVs sold in California. The program is still offering rebates through participating automakers, including Ford (F.N) , GM (GM.N) , Honda (7267.T) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Kia, Toyota (7203.T) and its Lexus brand, Lucid, Nissan (7201.T) , Rivian (RIVN.O) , Subaru <9778.T>, and Volvo. There are no funds remaining for Tesla models under the program, which includes $135.5 million in state funding and $135.5 million from participating automakers. The federal government has dropped support for EVs and charging programs. Trump signed legislation in 2025 that killed the federal $7,500 EV tax credit and the federal $4,000 used EV credit, which has reduced US sales. California's previous rebate program ended in 2023 and spent $1.49 billion to subsidize 586,000 EV purchases over a decade. Trump has taken aim at EVs on a number of fronts, including signing legislation in June 2025 against California's rules adopted by nearly a dozen other states that aim to phase out new gasoline-powered cars by 2035. California has sued to challenge the procedure used to reverse the landmark EV rules. The administration has finalized other changes that will save automakers billions of dollars in purchasing credits from Tesla (TSLA.O) and others to meet prior regulatory requirements.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（16日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
続伸して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は３日続伸。週間ベースでは３．１３％高で、上昇率は約半年...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（16日） 4:15 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

続伸して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は３日続伸。週間ベースでは３．１３％高で、上昇率は約半年ぶりの大きさだった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．４５％高、週間では１．３２％上昇した。

英政権の財政規律重視の予算編成方針が好感され、週間ベースでＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は６．４８％高。飲料株指数は７．７５％、ヘルスケア株指数は５．４８％それぞれ上昇した。

ブリティッシュ・アメリカン・タバコは前日比２．１％高。酒造大手のディアジオは１．９％上昇した。

銀行株指数は、銀行への課税の可能性が伝えられ、下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は０．４５％高。防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは２．６％、バブコック・インターナショナルは３．６％それぞれ上昇した。

通期利益見通しを引き上げた電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手ＴＨＧは１０．８％高だった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続伸して取引を終えた。堅調な企業業績を受けて買い注文が優勢だった。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは２．０９％上昇した。

ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳのデータによると、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種の構成企業全体の２０２６年７─９月期の利益は、前年同期比２０．７％増と見込まれている。

堅調な受注が確認されたドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは前日比６．２％高。通期の利益率見通しを引き上げたドイツの風力タービンメーカー、ノルデックスは１２．３％高。一方、配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは１．８％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は０．０６％高。週間では３．３９％下落した。

食品・飲料株指数は前日比１．３７％高。ＪＰモルガンが投資判断を引き上げたスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．７％上昇した。

一方、ヘルスケア株指数は０．２５％安だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが横ばいで推移した。ただ、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が巨額支出に見合うリターンを上げられるかどうかへの懸念から、国債には安全資産として買いが入っており、週間ベースでは低下の見通しとなった。

今週初め、ＡＩ関連投資に絡み債務が膨らんだ企業の株式・社債が大きく売られたことが、株式市場全般の重しとなり、投資家は国債に回帰した。世界の国債市場は週間ベースでは４カ月ぶりの大幅上昇に向かっており、ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の国債利回りは平均で８．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．２７３％となった。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルのアナリストは「ＡＩブームを巡る懸念が国債の投資妙味を高めている」と指摘。ただ、「こうした局面は過去にもあった」とした上で、これがＡＩ投資に対する熱狂やサイクルの終わりを意味するとは思わないとの見方を示した。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．４２％前後で推移した。ただ、週間では約７ｂｐ低下した。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは２ｂｐ低下の３．０６％となった。

ここ数週間で最も大きく売られてきたフランス１０年債利回りは４．７９％前後と横ばいで推移した。週間では７ｂｐ低下と、８月序盤以来の低下幅となる見通し。財政問題に対処する仏政府の能力を巡り、市場では根深い懸念が広がっている。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約１３７ｂｐ。今月２日には約１６０ｂｐと１５年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

市場は、今月のＥＣＢ理事会で利上げが実施されるとの見方は織り込んでいないものの、１２月には１００％の確率で利上げが行われると予想。来年４月までに少なくとももう１回追加利上げに踏み切るとみている。

item.title: US appeals court blocks class actions over Tesla's self-driving claims
item.description: A US appeals court threw out on Friday an order allowing Tesla customers in California to pursue class action claims accusing the electric vehicle maker of misleading them about the capabilities of its full self-driving technology.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A US appeals court threw out on Friday an order allowing Tesla (TSLA.O) customers in California to pursue class action claims accusing the electric vehicle maker of misleading them about the capabilities of its full self-driving technology. In its ruling , a three-judge panel of the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals said there were too many individualized questions about what buyers actually saw before making a purchase, and so they could not sustain their lawsuit as a class action. The appeals court decision is a win for now for Tesla, which had urged the appeals court to vacate orders by a California judge last year certifying three sets of classes. The ruling means the thousands of California buyers the lower court had grouped together cannot, for now, pursue their claims jointly in a single case. The ruling is not on the merits of the plaintiffs' lawsuit alleging false advertising, and the case remains pending. The plaintiffs contend Tesla is misrepresenting its vehicles' hardware capabilities for full self-driving, convincing customers to pay extra money for software that they say does not work. In a statement, the plaintiffs' lawyers said "we think the panel did not fully appreciate the unique circumstances here, and the importance of the hardware statement to Tesla's marketing campaign." Tesla did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Tesla has denied the plaintiffs' claims. In the underlying case, US District Judge Rita Lin last year [USN:L1N3UB0FD TEXT:"ruled"] that thousands of prospective buyers were likely exposed to Tesla's claim on its website that vehicles sold from October 2016 to the present contained hardware needed for full self-driving capability. But the appeals court panel — Circuit Judges Ronald Gould, Jay Bybee and Daniel Bress — said the plaintiffs could not show that all class members had been exposed to the allegedly false statement. The US Chamber of Commerce filed a court brief in support of Tesla and urged the appeals court to strike the class certification orders. The business advocate said the underlying ruling "threatens to substantially increase the costs to businesses and consumers of overbroad and meritless class proceedings."

item.title: Amazônia tem menor desmatamento já registrado em quase 40 anos
item.description: O desmatamento na Amazônia Legal caiu 42% entre agosto de 2025 e julho de 2026, de acordo com dados do sistema de satélite Prodes divulgados nesta sexta-feira, alcançando 3.335 km², menor nível registrado desde 1988, quando o governo brasileiro iniciou a coleta de dados.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: O desmatamento na Amazônia Legal caiu 42% entre agosto de 2025 e julho de 2026, de acordo com dados do sistema de satélite Prodes divulgados nesta sexta-feira, alcançando 3.335 km², menor nível registrado desde 1988, quando o governo brasileiro iniciou a coleta de dados. Nos últimos quatro anos, a queda foi de 71,2%. Os dados do Prodes também registraram uma queda recorde no desmatamento no Cerrado, que foi de 5.516 km², uma queda de 24% no último período, e o menor desde 2001, quando inicia a série histórica. Em quatro anos, a queda foi de 48,4%. Com os novos números, o Brasil recupera uma sequência de quedas no desmatamento que havia se interrompido em 2014, no caso da Amazônia, e 2019, no Cerrado. Em 2012, durante o mandato de Dilma Rousseff, o Brasil havia chegado ao recorde anterior, de 4.571 km² desmatados, depois de alcançado perto de 30 mil km² de vegetação suprimida nos anos 90. Já no Cerrado, o início dos anos 2000 foi quando se registrou os maiores desmatamentos, mas havia voltado a subir no governo de Jair Bolsonaro. A queda recomeçou em 2024. Mais cedo, durante a promulgação da Emenda Constitucional que acaba com a escala 6x1 no país, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva cumprimentou o ministro do Meio Ambiente, João Paulo Capobianco, pelos números registrados, que seriam os menores "em todos os biomas". Os dados de Pampa, Mata Atlântica, Cerrado e Pantanal ainda não foram divulgados.

item.title: Secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca Zacharia é demitida menos de uma semana depois de ser alvo de críticas
item.description: A secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca, Katie Zacharia, foi demitida após menos de uma semana no cargo, afirmaram duas autoridades nesta sexta-feira, após um início conturbado como principal porta-voz do presidente Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Nandita Bose, Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: A secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca, Katie Zacharia, foi demitida após menos de uma semana no cargo, afirmaram duas autoridades nesta sexta-feira, após um início conturbado como principal porta-voz do presidente Donald Trump. Zacharia foi “dispensada” e estava “deixando” o cargo de secretária de imprensa, segundo duas autoridades distintas da Casa Branca. Ela enfrentou dias de questionamentos sobre suas credenciais legais e críticas ao seu desempenho em uma coletiva de imprensa e em entrevistas. A saída deixa Trump sem uma importante porta-voz a pouco mais de duas semanas das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro, um período crítico em que o presidente busca divulgar as conquistas de seu governo e ajudar seus pares republicanos a manter o controle do Congresso. Trump disse aos repórteres na manhã desta sexta-feira que havia pedido a Zacharia que reconsiderasse se continuaria no cargo após enfrentar uma cobertura jornalística severa durante seus primeiros dias no cargo. “Eu disse a ela: ‘Acho que é melhor você ser feliz, e não tenho certeza se você conseguirá ser feliz nessa função’. Não há nada de fácil nisso”, disse Trump aos repórteres ao deixar a Casa Branca para uma viagem. Ele acrescentou: “Eu disse a ela com toda a sinceridade: ‘Se eu fosse você, reconsideraria... pensaria nisso. Mas eu reconsideraria’”. Trump disse que pretendia retomar a conversa com Zacharia mais tarde. Zacharia assumiu o cargo na segunda-feira e realizou sua primeira coletiva de imprensa na Casa Branca na terça-feira. Ela disse que recebeu uma ligação sobre o cargo de secretária de imprensa na última quarta-feira e que recebeu a oferta para suceder Karoline Leavitt na última sexta-feira. Logo ela enfrentou perguntas sobre sua carreira, que, segundo ela, incluiu uma passagem atuando como advogada. Trump também a havia descrito como advogada. “Atuei na área de direito de transações internacionais, com todas as credenciais necessárias”, disse Zacharia em um comunicado enviado por email na quarta-feira. A Reuters não conseguiu encontrar registros que comprovassem que a graduada pela faculdade de direito da Universidade Pepperdine estivesse registrada como advogada ou membro da Ordem dos Advogados em qualquer Estado dos EUA ou no Distrito de Columbia. Durante uma entrevista à Fox News na quinta-feira, Zacharia disse que não foi aprovada no exame da ordem. Graduados em direito não podem exercer legalmente a advocacia nos EUA sem primeiro serem admitidos na ordem dos advogados de um Estado. Zacharia e a Casa Branca não responderam imediatamente a um email solicitando comentários sobre sua demissão. Mais cedo nesta sexta-feira, ela disse a repórteres na Casa Branca que estava ansiosa para trabalhar com a imprensa. Trump contratou Zacharia após expressar preocupações com a cobertura da mídia sobre seu governo, sentindo que precisava de uma nova porta-voz que pudesse destacar suas conquistas, segundo duas pessoas a par das conversas. Em entrevista por telefone à Fox nesta sexta-feira, Trump disse que não tinha pressa em nomear uma nova secretária de imprensa. A rápida saída de Zacharia significou que ela teve o que se acredita ser o mandato mais curto de qualquer secretária de imprensa na história do cargo. “Recordes são feitos para serem quebrados”, disse Anthony Scaramucci, que atuou como diretor de comunicações por 10 dias durante o primeiro governo de Trump, no X. “Mas não sinto prazer com o sofrimento alheio.”

item.title: U.S. fiscal 2026 budget deficit rises to US$1.99 trillion, largest in 5 years
item.description: The U.S. budget deficit rose by US$217 billion to $1.99 trillion in the 2026 fiscal year, fuelled in part by tariff refunds and record spending to service the nation’s more-than $40 trillion in debt, ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: The U.S. budget deficit rose by US$217 billion to $1.99 trillion in the 2026 fiscal year, fuelled in part by tariff refunds and record spending to service the nation’s more-than $40 trillion in debt, marking the largest budget shortfall in five years, Treasury Department figures reported on Friday showed. The results for the year ended September 30, the first full budget year of U.S. President Donald Trump’s second term, compared to a $1.78 trillion deficit in fiscal 2025. It was the largest shortfall since fiscal 2021’s $2.77 trillion budget gap, then fueled by COVID-19 pandemic relief spending, and is the third- largest annual deficit ever. Total receipts for fiscal 2026 were a record $5.40 trillion, up $169 billion, or three per cent, from the $5.24 trillion in fiscal 2025. Fiscal 2026 outlays also were a record at $7.40 trillion, up $386 billion, or six per cent, from the $7.01 trillion in the prior fiscal year. Debt-service outlays totaled a record $1.36 trillion, climbing by $144 billion, or 12 per cent, a spending category now eclipsed only by Social Security and the combined outlays for Medicare and Medicaid. Total U.S. debt breached the $40 trillion milestone about two months ago. Another driver of the widening shortfall was a $22 billion drop in net tariff receipts following a U.S. Supreme Court ruling this year negating a large portion of the tariffs Trump had imposed during his first year in office. That triggered $145 billion of tariff refunds over this year, resulting in an 11 per cent decline in net tariff income to about $173 billion. A U.S. Treasury official said the department calculated an estimated deficit-to-GDP ratio of 6.2 per cent for fiscal 2026, but declined to say what GDP estimate was used. This figure compares to an actual 5.8 per cent deficit-to-GDP ratio for fiscal 2025. For the 2026 fiscal year’s final month of September, the Treasury reported a deficit of $27 billion versus a $198 billion surplus a year earlier. (Reporting by Dan Burns; Editing by Andrea Ricci)

item.title: ローマ教皇、プーチン氏とウ占領地の人道支援協力で合意 入院中に電話会談
item.description:
Joshua McElwee
[バチカン市国 １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国　１６日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は、ローマ教皇レオ１４世が１６日の電話会談で、ロシア占領下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシキに緊急物資を搬入するための協力を求めたのに対し、協力することで合意したと伝えた。ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）が明らかにした。

教皇庁（バチカン）によると、教皇はプーチン氏に電話し、オレシキへの救援物資や食料の搬入を可能にするため停戦を要請するとともに、同地の人道状況について「深い懸念」を表明した。

クレムリンは声明で「町の住民の安全を確保し、必要な物資供給を組織するために必要な環境を整える取り組みを支援するというバチカンの意向を支持した」とした上で、「この件に関して協力することで合意した」と表明。ただ、停戦については言及しなかった。

教皇は１３日に肺がん切除の手術を受けた後、ローマのジェメッリ病院で療養中。バチカンは１６日、教皇の容体は着実に改善しており、仕事や通常の日常生活をこなせる状態にあると明らかにしていた。

item.title: FAA set to approve Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, sources say
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration is set to approve the long-delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, after completing a key safety review on Friday, three people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: The Federal Aviation Administration is set to approve the long-delayed Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, after completing a key safety review on Friday, three people familiar with the matter said. The review by the Type Certification Board — made up of FAA management team members — is a final step before the agency decides on certification. The MAX 10 is a larger variant of Boeing's best-selling 737 MAX and its expected approval marks a key milestone for the US planemaker. Boeing has faced a more stringent certification process since two fatal MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019, as well as scrutiny of the company's production and quality systems after a January 2024 mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) MAX 9. Asked for comment, the FAA said, "Safety dictates the certification timeline." Boeing referred questions to the FAA. The FAA in August gave long-awaited approval to the smaller 737 MAX 7 after reviewing the plane for more than eight years. Boeing at one point planned to start delivering the MAX 10 in 2020. A problem with the anti-ice system on 737 MAX engines that arose in 2023 further delayed certification of the MAX 7 and 10. The delays have helped European rival Airbus' (AIR.PA) A321neo secure a greater share of the large single-aisle market. Boeing has said the MAX 10 will be a major cash-flow driver in its ongoing financial recovery following years of crises and controversies. Airlines have ordered nearly 1,500 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for about 30% of Boeing's outstanding 737 backlog. The planemaker has already built a handful of MAX 10s awaiting delivery. The bigger plane that can carry more passengers is crucial to several airlines' growth plans. Major customers for the MAX 10 include United Airlines (UAL.O) , Alaska, Ryanair (RYA.I) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and American Airlines (AAL.O) . A glitch with the latest update of the 737 MAX's navigation software threatened to further delay certification when Boeing disclosed it in late September. However, the FAA determined on October 2 that it did not pose a safety concern and did not require Boeing to fix the problem as a condition of certifying the plane. Boeing is still working on certifying the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production, which is already six years behind schedule. The company has said it expects to complete certification and begin deliveries in 2027.

item.title: ザカリア米大統領報道官「解任」、弁護士資格に疑問 トランプ氏「後任急がず」
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt Nandita Bose Jasper Ward
［ワシントン １６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Nandita Bose　Jasper Ward

［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ - 米ホワイトハウス当局者は１６日、ザカリア新大統領報道官が就任から１週間足らずで解任されたと明らかにした。ザカリア氏を巡っては弁護士資格を巡る疑問が浮上し、同氏は前日、司法試験に合格していないと認めていた。

ホワイトハウス当局者２人はロイターに対し、ザカリア氏は「解任された」とし、「報道官職を離れる方向で手続きが進められている」と明らかにした。これに先立ち、トランプ米大統領はザカリア氏に対し、世間の厳しい注目を受けたことを踏まえ、職務を再考するよう伝えたと述べていた。

ザカリア氏は１２日に大統領報道官に就任し、１３日にホワイトハウスで初めての記者会見を行ったばかり。ザカリア氏の退任により、トランプ大統領は１１月の中間選挙を２週間余り後に控えた重要な時期に、政権の実績を訴え、共和党の議会多数維持を後押しする政権の重要な「顔」を失うことになる。

トランプ氏はこの日、ＦＯＸニュースの電話インタビューに対し、新たな報道官の任命は急いでいないと述べた。

ロイターはザカリア氏のほか、ホワイトハウスに電子メールでコメントを求めたが、今のところ回答は得られていない。

ホワイトハウス当局者の話でザカリア氏の解任が伝わる前、トランプ大統領は記者団に対し「私はザカリア氏に『幸せでいる方がいいと思う。この仕事をしていて本当に幸せになれるか分からない。決して楽な仕事ではない』と言った」とし、「正直に言って、『私があなただったら考え直すだろう。よく考えてみるべきだ』と伝えた」と述べていた。

トランプ大統領は９日、８月に退任したレビット報道官の後任にザカリア氏を指名したと発表。ザカリア氏は、報道官就任について連絡を受けたのは７日で、９日に正式な打診を受けたとしている。１３日の記者会見ではわずか３人の記者の質問に答えただけで、１５分足らずで会見を終了した。

トランプ氏はザカリア氏の起用を発表した際、同氏を弁護士と紹介。ただその後、カリフォルニア州のペパーダイン大学ロースクールを卒業したザカリア氏が実際に司法試験に合格し、弁護士資格を持っているか疑問の声が上がっていた。ザカリア氏は１５日夜、ＦＯＸニュース番組のインタビューで、司法試験に合格していないと認めた。

ザカリア氏の米大統領報道官の在任期間としては史上最短だったとみられる。トランプ第１次政権でホワイトハウス広報部長（コミュニケーションズ・ディレクター）を１０日間務めたアンソニー・スカラムーチ氏は「記録は破られるためにある」とＸに投稿。同時に「私は他人の苦境を喜ぶつもりはない」とも記した。

item.title: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon falls to all-time low
item.description: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest declined to the lowest level on record in the 12 months through July, according to data released by Brazilian space research agency Inpe on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Andre Romani
item.content:encoded: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest declined to the lowest level on record in the 12 months through July, according to data released by Brazilian space research agency Inpe on Friday. Some 3,335 square kilometers (1,287.65 square miles) of Amazon jungle were destroyed in the 12 months through July, an all-time low in the historical series that goes back to 1988. It was a fall of about 42% from the preceding period. The previous lowest level for Brazil's Amazon deforestation was reached in 2011-2012, when 4,571 square kilometers were destroyed. In the mid-90s, the figure had reached a record high of nearly 30,000 square kilometers destroyed a year. The data released on Friday, which is produced yearly by Inpe's PRODES satellite monitoring program, is measured from August to July as there is less cloud cover in the middle of the year to obscure deforestation on satellite images. "The figures released today are a historic achievement," said Marcio Astrini, executive secretary at climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, adding they show the world that "with political will, it is possible to curb deforestation and greenhouse gas emissions." President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva took office in 2023 [USN:S0N37201F TEXT:"pledging to end deforestation"] by 2030, after it soared to its highest in 15 years during the administration of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Lula will face Bolsonaro's eldest son, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, in a [USN:S0N45N09L TEXT:"presidential election runoff"] on October 25, after the younger Bolsonaro performed better than expected in the first round. The senator pledged in his manifesto to strengthen environmental oversight in the Amazon, prioritizing areas under the greatest pressure from deforestation and wildfires. He said law enforcement would focus on organized crime rather than on extractive workers and small farmers. In Brazil's Cerrado savanna, deforestation fell about 24% in the period, to some 5,517 square kilometers, also the lowest on record in a series going back to 2001, Inpe data showed.

item.title: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Browns
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss his second straight game with an ankle injury on Sunday at Cleveland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss his second straight game with an ankle injury on Sunday at Cleveland. Tyler Huntley will start under center when the Ravens (4-1) visit the AFC North rival Browns (3-2). Jackson has not practiced since sustaining the injury late in the first half in the Week 4 win against the Tennessee Titans. Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said the decision was the right one for the two-time NFL MVP. "I think it's just a decision for his best interest," the first-year coach said Friday. "That's really what every decision's always going to be about." Jackson, 29, has completed 70.8% of his passes for 967 yards, six touchdowns and one interception in four games this season. He has rushed for 144 yards and one score. Huntley, 28, completed 24 of 32 passes for 201 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in last Sunday's 30-23 overtime win at Atlanta. His 1-yard touchdown run in overtime gave Baltimore its third straight win. Also, outside linebacker Trey Hendrickson (finger) will return after missing the past two games. Hendrickson underwent surgery before sitting out the contests. "We're always going to try to have the best interest of the player," Minter said. "The path that we went down was really in (Hendrickson's) best interest, both short-term and long-term. I'm excited for him to be back out there." Center Cam Jurgens (concussion), who was recently acquired from the Philadelphia Eagles, was also ruled out by the Ravens. Defensive tackle Broderick Washington (ankle) will sit out as well. Receiver Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) returned from injured reserve to practice and is listed as questionable. Also questionable are offensive guards Emery Jones Jr. (ankle) and Andrew Vorhees (foot). --Field Level Media

item.title: Analysis:Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare
item.description: LONDON/BENGALURU, Oct 16 : Loss-making and deeply indebted US cloud company CoreWeave became an easy target this week for investors concerned about an artificial intelligence bubble. Its selloff, though, has greater significance for markets than its size implies.The slump in the shares and bonds of the $39 bi

Analysis:Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare

FAST

LONDON/BENGALURU, Oct 16 : Loss-making and deeply indebted US cloud company CoreWeave became an easy target this week for investors concerned about an artificial intelligence bubble. Its selloff, though, has greater significance for markets than its size implies. The slump in the shares and bonds of the $39 billion Nvidia-backed AI infrastructure company came after third-quarter reports from hyperscalers hinted at delays in data center projects and a slower pace of growth in capital expenditure. Worried investors took aim at new-age AI-based cloud firms, or neoclouds, such as CoreWeave, conceivably the weakest links in the AI ecosystem because of how they borrow heavily to finance chips, land and energy for data centers which will yield income only in the future. CoreWeave's shares dived more than 15 per cent this week while yields on its 2030 bonds jumped 500 basis points to near 16 per cent.

CoreWeave chief Mike Intrator told employees in a memo, seen by Reuters, markets can sometimes "misunderstand and act irrationally" and it has a strong pipeline of demand. The company did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment. Investors focused instead on its $50 billion debt and the perils of being trapped in the middle of a circular financing arrangement between chipmakers such as Nvidia and clients such as Meta Platforms and OpenAI. "The problem with this stuff is that we're talking about huge interconnectedness, not just circular financing but the fact that these assets are all held in the same places, in the same portfolios, by the same types of investors," said James Athey, fixed-income portfolio manager at Marlborough. "And leverage is always that thing which turns a storm into a teacup into something more nefarious," he said, referring broadly to the AI jitters. Companies such as CoreWeave, Nebius, Applied Digital, Iren, Lambda Labs, Crusoe and TeraWulf are building energy-intensive data centers they can eventually rent out to firms developing and running AI models. That calls for massive upfront investment and very little income until the leases begin. CoreWeave has never turned a profit, according to data compiled by LSEG. CoreWeave's CEO also said in the memo that its deal backlog more than covers its debt obligations. The company had a $104.2 billion revenue backlog at the end of the second quarter, followed by more than $25 billion in new commitments early in the third quarter. But the New Jersey-based company is burning cash faster than investors like. In 2025, CoreWeave reported annual revenue of $5.1 billion and a net loss of $1.2 billion. While revenue is expected to double this year, capital expenditure is estimated to be up fourfold to between $35 billion and $39 billion, leading to even more cash burn this year. News that Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock since the company's IPO in March last year, mostly under prearranged trading plans as per regulatory filings, has not helped. "Clearly they will need a capital injection or a bailout. They are burning capital, and capital is no longer free," said Alberto Gallo, founder of hedge fund Andromeda Capital. "You want to buy debt in businesses that have visible cash flow, typically as a bond investor, not someone that is doing capex, in the hope that there will be more capex needed in the future," he said. The firm holds bets against CoreWeave bonds. DOUBTS APLENTY CoreWeave is at the top of the 100-odd neoclouds that research firm Gartner Inc says are "the most exposed to the imbalance between revenue and capital spending" and need to soon earn returns to sustain operations. Gartner expects that by 2030, 80 per cent of neocloud providers will cease independent operations. "We are in a situation in which there are a lot of expectations on revenues and revenue growth, but this revenue growth is being fueled by the wrong type of capital, which is debt, not equity," said Tommaso Leodari, Dubai-based chief investment officer of hedge fund Index & Cie. The fund does not hold stakes in pure AI firms. "In the specific case of CoreWeave, these guys are financing their entire business with debt. So if anything happens in the utilization of this particular asset or if there is a slowing down on the construction of these data centers, it will reflect in problems in repaying the debt." A streak of warnings from AI hyperscalers such as Microsoft and Oracle Corp on delays in data center projects, power and component bottlenecks, a glut in high-end chips, alongside plans by giants such as Meta and Microsoft to launch their own chips to rival Nvidia's, have also stoked concerns about neoclouds. The pace at which revenue is growing at AI giants such as OpenAI and Anthropic, while still fast, has also softened. "Even at $10 billion revenue, CoreWeave is losing $2.5 billion, so there are no scale effects in the industry clear as yet," wrote Michael Frazis of Sydney-based Frazis Capital Partners. CoreWeave has Nvidia's backing. The chip giant has agreed to buy unsold CoreWeave compute capacity through April 2032, guaranteeing it will have a buyer for capacity not sold to customers. Ratings agencies have CoreWeave's debt marked as speculative grade, yet Sean Cray, vice president at Moody’s Ratings, pointed out the company does not speculatively purchase chips and has multiple avenues for financing. Originally a bitcoin miner, CoreWeave has still been an easy mark for punters, and hedge funds have been buying its junk-rated bonds for the high yield. The cost of insuring its debt against default climbed to about 1,200 basis points this week, signalling severe distress. "CoreWeave's credit selloff risks becoming a self-fulfilling prophecy," wrote Saurav Sen at research firm Gimme Credit. "The concern is less whether customers want the capacity than whether CoreWeave can afford to deliver it."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Indian police detain 'cockroach' founder, student leaders ahead of Delhi rally
item.description: Indian police detained protest leader Abhijeet Dipke and several protesters demanding the election chief's resignation over the removal of more than 130 million voters from the voter lists.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Asia

Indian police detain 'cockroach' founder, student leaders ahead of Delhi rally

Indian police detained protest leader Abhijeet Dipke and several protesters demanding the election chief's resignation over the removal of more than 130 million voters from the voter lists.

Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) and Neha Bora, national president of the All India Students' Association (AISA) gesture as they addresses a press conference in New Delhi, India, Oct 15, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Adnan Abidi)

17 Oct 2026 01:31AM (Updated: 17 Oct 2026 06:40AM)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Police detain ed India's "cockroach" movement founder Abhijeet Dipke, student leaders and supporters on Friday (Oct 16) as hundreds poured into central Delhi, waving the national flag and demand ing the resignation of India's election chief. The youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), opposition groups and student organisations have held near- daily protests this month demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over a revision of voter lists th ey say favours Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). More than 130 million voters were deleted during the revision . T he Election Commission has denied favouring any party and said wrongly deleted voters can re-enrol. The BJP has accused rivals of trying to undermine democracy by wrongly questioning legitimate electoral processes. Dipke called Friday's protest in support of two CJP leaders detain ed and sent to jail this week for five days for demonstrating at a protest site in violation of a ban.

The group and left-wing student organisations had urged supporters to gather at Central Park in New Delhi 's busy Connaught Place shopping and food district on Friday evening to wave and hoist the national flag.

Protestors amid security personnels chant slogans as they take part in a flag rally by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) seeking the resignation of India's Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, in New Delhi, India, Oct 16, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra)

POLICE SAY THEY WARNED MOVEMENT LEADER AGAINST PROTESTING Dipke was detain ed as he stepped out of a house in central Delhi , with police hauling him into a police car and driving away after a brief argument. Student activist Neha Bora, a prominent face of the protests, was also detain ed as she tried to reach Connaught Place with dozens of supporters. Senior police officer Sachin Sharma told Reuters that Dipke and Bora had been taken into preventive detention. "Abhijeet is detain ed by Delhi Police ," CJP posted on X. "This government is so scared of the youth waving national flag." Earlier on Friday, police had met Dipke and warned him against going ahead with the protest. Security was stepped up , w ith hundreds of police in riot gear fanning out across central Delhi. The park was shut by civic authorities. Nevertheless, nearly 500 protesters managed to reach Connaught Place in groups and protested in about half a dozen places around the Central Park, waving flags and shouting slogans. A few were detained and taken away in a police vehicle. "If waving the tricolour in the country has become a crime, then I am happy to go to jail," said Saurav Kumar, a data analyst, before he was detained. "The government not giving us the space to protest, not accepting faults in the system is not a healthy sign for a democracy." Small protests were also held in the financial capital Mumbai and tech hub Bengaluru, while student organisations held a demonstration in the eastern city of Patna, with people waving flags of their organisations and pushing against police barricades.

Protestors chant slogans as they take part in a flag rally by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) seeking the resignation of India's Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, in New Delhi, India, Oct 16, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra)

YOUTH USED AS PAWNS, BJP SAYS The cockroach movement has emerged as one of the biggest political challenges faced by Modi and his BJP in his 12 years in power. A weeks-long sit-in by its supporters earlier this year forced Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over exam paper leaks. The latest demonstrations erupted after the Indian Express newspaper reported that Kumar's two deputies had raised concerns internally about voter list changes, registration procedures and digital systems. The 130 million names that were removed from voter lists starting last year - equivalent to more than the population of Japan - included 28 million people who had died, 63 million who relocated, and 30 million who could not be traced, according to the Election Commission. Opposition parties allege the deletions disproportionately affect Muslims and other minorities who are unlikely to support the Hindu nationalist ruling party, allegations the commission and the BJP reject. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said the demonstrations were the main opposition Congress party's attempt to "seize power". "Instead of channelling the energy of the youth toward nation-building, they are being used as pawns in the politics of anarchy," he said at a media briefing on Friday.

item.title: White House press secretary Zacharia fired in less than a week after facing criticism
item.description: The move comes after Trump said he had told her to reconsider the job following public scrutiny. Trump had described Zacharia as an attorney when he announced her appointment. Reuters could not find records showing she was registered as an attorney or member of the bar in any state or the District of Columbia.
item.dc:creator: Nandita Bose, Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: White House press secretary [USN:FWN45V14O TEXT:"Katie Zacharia"] was fired after less than a week on the job, two US officials said on Friday, after a rocky start as President Donald Trump 's top spokesperson. Zacharia was "let go" and is "transitioning out" of the press secretary position, according to two separate White House officials. She faced days of questions about her [USN:L6N4601D0 TEXT:"legal credentials"] and criticism of her performance in a news briefing and interviews. The departure leaves Trump without a key public messenger just over two weeks before November's midterm elections , a critical period when the president is seeking to tout his administration's accomplishments and help his fellow Republicans retain control of Congress. Trump told reporters earlier on Friday that he had asked Zacharia to reconsider whether to continue in her role after facing tough press coverage during her first days on the job. "I told her: 'I think you're better off being happy, and I'm not sure you can ever be happy in this stuff.' There's nothing easy about this stuff," Trump told reporters as he departed the White House for a weekend trip. He added: "I said to her honestly, 'If I were you, I'd reconsider... think about it. But I would reconsider.'" Trump said he intended to revisit the conversation with Zacharia later. Zacharia started on Monday and held her debut White House briefing on Tuesday. She said she received a call about the press secretary role on October 7 and was offered the job to succeed [USN:FWN4491F6 TEXT:"Karoline Leavitt"] a week ago. She soon faced questions about her career, which she said included a tenure practicing law. Trump had also described her as an attorney. "I practiced international transaction law, with all the appropriate credentials," Zacharia said in an emailed statement on Wednesday. Reuters could not find records showing the Pepperdine University law school graduate was registered as an attorney or member of the bar in any US state or the District of Columbia. During a Fox News interview on Thursday, Zacharia said she [USN:L1N46201S TEXT:"did not pass the bar"] exam. Law school graduates cannot legally practice law in the US without first being admitted to a state bar. Zacharia and the White House did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment about her firing. Earlier on Friday, she told reporters at the White House that she was looking forward to working with the press. Trump hired Zacharia after expressing concerns about the media coverage of his administration, feeling he needed a new spokesperson who could amplify his achievements, according to two people familiar with the conversations. In a phone interview with Fox on Friday, Trump said he was in no rush to name a new press secretary. Zacharia's quick exit meant she had what is believed to be the shortest tenure of any press secretary in the role's history. "Records are made to be broken," Anthony Scaramucci, who served as director of communications for 10 days during Trump's first administration, said on X. "But I take no pleasure in other people's pain."

item.title: Thames Water wins majority support among key Class B creditors for recapitalisation
item.description: Thames Water said on Friday it had reached an agreement with key Class B creditors on a proposed recapitalisation, securing support from holders of more than 60% of its junior Class B debt and advancing efforts to restructure Britain's biggest water utility.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Thames Water said on Friday it had reached an agreement with key Class B creditors on a proposed recapitalisation, securing support from holders of more than 60% of its junior Class B debt and advancing efforts to restructure Britain's biggest water utility. The proposal would see about £1 billion ($1.33 billion) of Class B debt written off, with those creditors receiving a roughly 5.9% recovery through equity and other rights in the restructured company in return. The deal marks progress for Thames Water's senior creditors, known as London & Valley Water consortium, who are pursuing a rescue plan involving debt writedowns and fresh equity investment to avert temporary government control of the utility. L&VW declined to comment. The utility, weighed down by about £20 billion in debt, is seeking to overhaul its debt-laden balance sheet through a broader recapitalisation as it works to improve its finances and services amid mounting fines for polluting rivers with sewage. On Thursday, Thames Water [USN:L8N4611UT TEXT:"said"] it needed to increase its emergency funding facility by £2.4 billion to £5.4 billion to avoid running out of cash before its planned recapitalisation is completed. Thames Water said talks with L&VW and regulators on the proposed recapitalisation were ongoing, with no decision yet taken on whether to proceed with the consortium's rescue plan. The future of Thames Water is being closely watched after Prime Minister Andy Burnham last month [USN:L8N45L19H TEXT:"pledged"] legislation allowing public ownership of water companies while the government and regulators consider the L&VW rescue plan for the utility. ($1 = 0.7511 pounds)

item.title: 米当局、ＡＩ悪用の選挙妨害に警戒呼び掛け 11月の中間選挙控え
item.description: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）とサイバーセキュリティー・インフラセキュリティー庁（ＣＩＳＡ）は１６日、来月の中間選挙を控え、人工知能（ＡＩ）を悪用した手口に警戒するよう選挙関係者と国民に呼び掛けた。

ＦＢＩとＣＩＳＡの警告によると、ハッカーはパスワードやその他の機密データを盗み出すための偽のテキストメッセージや電子メールを用いて、中間選挙を妨害しようとする恐れがあるという。

警告では「選挙関係者や候補者、その政治組織は、悪意あるサイバー犯罪者にとって魅力的な標的となっている」と指摘した。

また、トランプ米大統領が変更を主張するＡＩの呼称である「スーパーインテリジェンス」（超知能、ＳＩ）により、ハッカーは不正な電子メールやテキストメッセージをより説得力のあるものに見せかけるよう巧妙化させていると述べた。

item.title: Teacher tackled and fought Oregon school shooter
item.description: A teacher in the Oregon classroom where a shooter killed three children and an adult threw her cellphone at the shooter, tackled him and fought him in an act that saved lives, police said.
item.dc:creator: Herbert Villarraga, Deborah Bloom
item.content:encoded: A teacher in the Oregon classroom where a shooter killed three children and an adult threw her cellphone at the shooter, tackled him and fought him in an act that saved lives, police said on Friday. A day into their investigation of the latest U.S. school shooting, authorities released new details of the scene inside a special needs classroom of Silver Rail Elementary School where three school children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed by a 16-year-old former student. Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz did not identify the teacher who fought the assailant, but told a press conference she threw her cell phone at the suspect, tackled him and fought to take his shotgun from him. "She was not injured in that incident, but she almost certainly helped prevent more bloodshed," Krantz said. As the two wrestled, a parent entered the classroom and opened fire on the gunman, killing him. Officials said the parent had followed the shooter into the school, upon witnessing him firing a shotgun from just outside campus. By the time police arrived within three minutes of receiving their first call, the shooter was dead, police said. In the meantime the 16-year-old assailant, who had shot through locked glass doors to enter campus, had killed four people and wounded two others. Krantz, speaking to the heroism shown by the teacher who threw herself onto the suspect and the parent who shot him, said, "I don't think we can underestimate or under-appreciate that courage. When someone is willing to risk their own life for others, we recognize that." He said that the bystander's actions "undoubtedly saved people," and "the teacher who was willing to stand and fight for her children, that's true heroism." Krantz identified the shooter as Griffin J. John II, who was armed with 12-gauge shotgun. He fired about 15 rounds in the classroom and had another 44 rounds on him. The parent who killed the shooter was identified as Kaylub Giamanco, his mother told the New York Times. She identified him as the father of two girls who attend the school, according to video posted by the New York Times of Freeman reading a brief statement. "He is not seeking recognition, but instead wishes to express his gratitude to the first responders, school personnel, and community for the outpouring of love and support," Freeman said. "Kaylub's family, including his two daughters who attend the school, respectfully asks for privacy during this difficult time, and will not be participating in interviews at this time." Residents of Bend, a city of about 100,000 people some 175 miles (280 km) southeast of Portland, gathered near the school to mourn on Friday morning, placing flowers and candles just outside yellow crime scene tape that cordoned off the scene. "Thank God for that father. He saved a lot of lives yesterday, and our prayers should go out for him because he has a lot on his mind today. We wish him well, and thank God for him," Michael Zappa, 71, who lives just blocks from the school, said through tears. Brooke Olsen, the mother of a kindergartener who was safely reunited with her family after the shooting, also expressed gratitude for the man who stopped the shooter. "This is an extremely painful day of grief for everybody in Bend, especially Silver Rail families, and we have to think about what's next for safety measures." Such school shootings have become common in the US, with each one reviving debates over gun laws in a country where a right to "keep and bear Arms" is protected under the Constitution's Second Amendment. Some of the deadliest school attacks in the US include those at Columbine High School in 1999, Sandy Hook Elementary School in 2012, Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in 2018 and Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, in 2022.

item.title: CoreWeave's CEO sold nearly $1 billion of stock since IPO, filings show
item.description: CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock, mostly under prearranged trading plans, since the AI cloud company's IPO in March last year, according to regulatory filings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CoreWeave (CRWV.O) CEO Michael Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock, mostly under prearranged trading plans, since the AI cloud company's IPO in March last year, according to regulatory filings. The sales began about two months after the stock hit a record high in June 2025. The shares have tumbled since and were on track to lose about 24% this week [USN:L4N4620ZT TEXT:"as investors worried about"] the Nvidia-backed company's heavy capital spending and the debt needed to fund it amid rising bets on interest-rate hikes. CoreWeave did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Here are some more details: The sales totaled more than 10 million shares, according to the filings. As of Thursday's close, CoreWeave had a valuation of $38.44 billion. The sales were made by Intrator and affiliated entities such as Omnadora Capital, where Intrator serves as managing member, and two trusts. Most of these sales, excluding roughly $40 million, were made under prearranged trading plans that allow executives to sell shares on a preset schedule, and do not necessarily reflect management's view of the business. The roughly $40 million that was not part of prearranged plans was sell-to-cover sales, where shares were sold on the market to pay taxes on vested stock. The selling occurred as CoreWeave rapidly expanded its data-center footprint and increased spending on Nvidia chips to meet demand for AI computing, while building a revenue backlog of [USN:L6N4590TM TEXT:"more than $129 billion"]. In August, the company raised its annual capital expenditure forecast to be between [USN:L4N4481ER TEXT:"$35 billion and $39 billion"].

item.title: 米ロ軽油合意、なし崩し的に制裁緩和の恐れ＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description:
Yuliia Dysa
［キーウ １６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yuliia Dysa

［キーウ　１６日　ロイター］ - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１６日、トランプ米大統領がロシアと結んだ軽油供給合意について、戦争を終わらせる意思を示さない侵略国に対する一段の制裁緩和に道を開くことになり、世界的なリスクにつながると警告した。

イラン戦争による燃料価格高騰の責任を、ロシアの製油所に対するウクライナ軍の攻撃に転嫁しようとするトランプ氏の姿勢も非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏は欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議出席のため訪問中のブリュッセルで記者団に対し、「こうした軽油取引や合意は受け入れられない。次はガス取引、ガスの後には他の分野でも制裁が解除されるだろう。いずれ銀行システムや個人、化学産業にまで及ぶことになる」と厳しい認識を示した。

トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表した。nL6N45V0Z6

ロシアが２０２２年にウクライナへの全面侵攻を開始して以来、ロシア産化石燃料には段階的に制裁が科されてきた。ウクライナ政府は同盟国に対し、こうした供給への依存を終わらせるよう繰り返し求めている。

item.title: Trump move to restart direct US flights with Lebanon hits roadblock
item.description: The United Nations aviation agency has found Lebanon's main airport lacks valid certification, according to a report summary seen by Reuters, in a setback to US President Donald Trump's move to revive direct US-Beirut flights.
item.dc:creator: Allison Lampert, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The United Nations aviation agency has found Lebanon's main airport lacks valid certification, according to a report summary seen by Reuters, in a setback to US President Donald Trump's move to revive direct US-Beirut flights. Trump made the announcement in July and signed an order last month for [USN:FWN43N0RD TEXT:"the US government"] to allow direct flights from the US to Lebanon, reversing a four-decade-long suspension after TWA Flight 847 was hijacked and forced to land in Beirut in 1985. While the US Federal Aviation Administration and the Transportation Security Administration would still need to conduct safety reviews before flights could resume, the Lebanese embassy in Washington called Trump's order "a significant first step toward restoring direct air service between Lebanon and the United States." However, the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) technical assistance mission to Lebanon in July identified shortcomings at Beirut-Rafic Hariri International Airport and in the aviation system. The findings, which two senior industry officials familiar with the matter expect to delay the resumption of service, complicate efforts to follow up on an order Trump signed after meeting Lebanese President Joseph Aoun. Washington has backed Aoun as it pushes for Iran-backed Hezbollah to be disarmed. The agency sent its internal report, made at the request of the Lebanese Civil Aviation Authority (LCAA), to Lebanon in September. AIRPORT LACKS EMERGENCY PLAN: ICAO Beirut airport's firefighting resources are equipped for single-aisle planes, but not twin-aisle jetliners used for long-haul flights, according to a summary of ICAO's report. The airport also lacks an emergency plan, and its conditional certification has expired, the report said. "This is a serious and time-critical matter that must be addressed immediately to preserve the airport's operational status," the summary said. The report also found the Lebanese regulator LCAA lacks qualified inspectors to oversee air traffic control licensing, and has no fully established, operational and independent aircraft accident investigation authority with clearly defined roles. Such concerns were flagged during a two-day workshop last month where officials from ICAO, Lebanon's government, the FAA and others discussed efforts to revive direct air service, according to the industry officials and an agenda of the meeting seen by Reuters. Lebanon's Minister of Public Works and Transport Fayez Rasamny said Lebanon was taking steps to address the concerns, with efforts to certify the airport starting on Saturday. The LCAA expects to issue conditional certification in the coming days. "Most of the issues highlighted in the report had already been identified by the LCAA, and corrective action had already been initiated," Rasamny said in a statement, adding that progress had been delayed by war. Israeli forces remain in southern Lebanon and have continued strikes despite a US-brokered framework agreement signed in June between Israel and Lebanon. Hezbollah, which was not party to the deal, has rejected it. The FAA declined to comment. ICAO said it cannot comment on matters concerning specific countries, but said it conducts targeted analyses for member states. The US State Department advises Americans not to travel to Lebanon given safety concerns. It said the FAA advises caution for flights operating in Lebanese airspace due to heightened military activity in or around Syria, including the risks of errant long-range surface-to-air missiles originating from Syrian territory. MIDDLE EAST UNREST DISRUPTS AIR TRAVEL Foreign airlines have avoided large swathes of Middle East airspace because of missile and drone threats since US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February triggered regional hostilities, with an [USN:L6N4600LI TEXT:"airport"] in Saudi Arabia the latest site to come under attack. Lebanon and its national carrier have been praised domestically for maintaining air navigation services and flights, helping to prop up an economy that depends on tourism and remittances. Three US airline officials told Reuters on the condition of anonymity they do not think any American carriers would resume flights to Lebanon in the near term, citing security concerns. While there are no direct flights between Beirut and the United States, such service exists between Lebanon and some large European cities. The European Union Aviation Safety Agency said it was aware of the ICAO report and added that EU airlines must conduct their own assessment of an airport's safety and operational readiness before launching services.

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナ領内に「安保地帯」設置へ 交渉対象外＝プーチン氏
item.description: [モスクワ １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１６日、ウクライナとの国境沿いのウクライナ領内で「安全保障地帯」の設置を進めていると明らかにし、将来的にウクライナと交渉が行われた場合でも、この安全保障地帯は交渉の対象にしないと述べた。

プーチン氏はこの日、軍服姿でロシア軍統合部隊の指揮所を視察。安全保障地帯の設置は２０２４─２５年にウクライナ軍がロシア西部クルスク州に侵攻したことへの対応になると説明し、「ロシア軍には、ロシア領から敵を排除する任務に加え、隣接地域に安全保障地帯を設ける任務も与えられている。この任務は成功裏に遂行されている」と述べた。

その上で、安全保障地帯の設置は「将来にわたりロシアの国境地域の絶対的な安全を確保すること」が目的だとし、これをウクライナとの和平交渉の議題にする考えはないと語った。

また、ロシア軍はウクライナ東部ドネツク州の制圧を進めているものの、同州の約１０％をまだ掌握できていないとも述べた。

ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官によると、計画されている安全保障地帯の総延長は６６０キロ。このうち約７０％はロシアがすでに支配下に置いているとしている。

プーチン氏の発言はテレビ中継された。

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米ロ軽油取引は「プーチン氏の懐に資金」 ＥＵ首脳会議
item.description:
Lili Bayer Andrew Gray Yuliia Dysa
[ブリュッセル／キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Lili Bayer　Andrew Gray　Yuliia Dysa

[ブリュッセル／キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１６日、トランプ米大統領がロシアと結んだ軽油取引の合意を批判する一方、欧州の同盟国が和平交渉で役割を拡大する可能性を歓迎した。ロシアの姿勢については、和平交渉の「茶番」だと述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏はブリュッセルで開かれた欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議で、ロシアは和平を望んでいないと指摘。戦場での作戦や、前線から遠く離れた都市を攻撃するロシアの無人機の撃墜に使うスペースＸの衛星システム「スターシールド」に、依然として障害が生じていると述べた。

トランプ氏がロシアの製油所に対するウクライナの攻撃を「恥ずべきこと」と呼び、同国を再び批判する中、ＥＵ首脳はゼレンスキー氏への支持を示した。ゼレンスキー氏は首脳会議への到着時、出席する各国首脳を、あえて「真の指導者たち」と呼んだ。

ＥＵがゼレンスキー氏を迎えたのは、ウクライナにとって極めて厳しい局面だった。国内の都市にはミサイルや無人機による攻撃が降り注ぎ、米国が情報共有や武器支援を縮小する恐れも出ている。

それでも、ゼレンスキー氏の発言からは、米国に対する姿勢を軟化させる意向はほとんどうかがえない。記者会見で、トランプ氏からエネルギー価格の高騰やイラン戦争の展開について責任を押し付けられていると感じるかと問われると、長い間を置いてほほ笑み、「これが私の答えだ」と述べ、会場の笑いを誘った。

＜「プーチン氏の懐に資金」＞

トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表した。

この合意は、ウクライナや欧州の同盟国の反発を招いた。

ゼレンスキー氏は首脳会議に合わせて開いた記者会見で「今や、この軽油取引を通じて、資金が再びロシアに流れ込み始めることが分かる。この軽油取引では、ホルムズ海峡の情勢が世界市場に及ぼす影響を到底相殺できない。しかし、プーチン氏の懐に直接入る資金を増やし、この戦争の資金源になる」と語った。

また、ロシアのプーチン大統領はいかなる形の和平交渉にも関心がないと非難した。「プーチン氏は今、どのような形であれ和平交渉を望んでいない。自分たちは対応していると主張し、言葉遊びをしている。率直に言えば、戦争を終わらせたいという真の意思を装った茶番に見える」と語った。

ゼレンスキー氏はＥＵ首脳に対する演説で「２７年の戦費は１５５０億ユーロに上る。防衛や武器、そしてわれわれが持ちこたえるために、皆さんから少なくとも７００億ユーロの追加支援が必要だ。これは現実的な金額だ。この支援を確保してほしい。ロシアを食い止める助けになる」と訴えた。演説内容は後にＸに投稿した。

＜ＥＵ首脳の苦慮＞

ウクライナ指導部は、スターシールドの障害に危機感を強めている。

スターシールドは、米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸが展開する衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」を基盤とする軍事・政府機関向けシステムで、ウクライナ軍はドローン（無人機）運用や部隊間通信に活用している。

米当局者は、トランプ氏がスターシールドの意図的な速度低下を指示したことを否定した。トランプ氏も今週、ウクライナとの情報共有は続いていると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、稼働状況は改善したものの、まだ完全には復旧していないと説明。障害が民間人を危険にさらしていると述べた。

ＥＵのカラス外交安全保障上級代表は「スターリンクはウクライナにとって本当に必要だ。残念ながら、欧州は短期的にはこの機能を代替できない」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領は１５日放映のニュースマックスのインタビューで、ウクライナによるロシア製油所への攻撃再開は「恥ずべきこと」であり、世界のエネルギー価格の高止まりを招いていると述べた。

ロシアも、製油所への無人機攻撃を公に認め、国営メディアで映像を放映した。通常の対応とは異なり、攻撃を大きく取り上げるためだった。

ＥＵ首脳は、米国がロシア産軽油を購入する合意を批判する一方、イラン戦争以降に急騰したエネルギー価格への対応にも苦慮している。首脳会議初日の１５日には、加盟国間の対立が浮き彫りになった。

１６日も隔たりは埋まっていない。スウェーデンのクリステション首相は、ＥＵ自体の予算を取りまとめる上で、加盟国の立場は「信じられないほどかけ離れている」と述べた。「この問題では、合意の兆しどころか、そのかけらすらない」と語った。

item.title: ハンガリー首相、ゼレンスキー氏と初会談 両国関係の再構築で合意
item.description: [ブダペスト １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブダペスト　１６日　ロイター] - ハンガリーのマジャル首相は１６日、ブリュッセルでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と初会談し、両国関係を再構築することで合意したと明らかにした。

マジャル氏は「ロシアの非人道的な侵略に対して、ウクライナへの全面的な連帯を確約した」と交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）フェイスブックに投稿。ロシアとの停戦や恒久的な和平の実現に向け、あらゆる外交手段を用いて支援する用意があると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は今回の会談について「非常に良かった」と評価。多くの議題を協議したとし、今後ハンガリーを訪問することもあり得るとした。

ハンガリーのオルバン前首相は、ウクライナへの支援や欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟に反対していた。政権交代で首相に就いたマジャル氏は対立を避ける姿勢を取りつつ、ウクライナのハンガリー系少数民族の権利に関する進展を求めてきた。また、ウクライナに武器を供与しないと繰り返し発言している。会談を受け「権利強化を巡って合意したことを歓迎する」とし、ウクライナ議会による少数民族の教育に関する法案の可決について「相互の信頼関係を回復するための第一歩になる」と述べた。

ウクライナ議会が今月法案を可決したことを受け、マジャル政権はウクライナのＥＵ加盟の取り組みへの反対を撤回。ウクライナは１３日、域内市場と競争力に関する基準を巡ってＥＵとの協議を開始した。

item.title: Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to vacate $5 million settlement
item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : A federal judge in Manhattan has rejected a joint request by the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission and Gemini, a cryptocurrency exchange founded by twin brothers Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, to undo a $5 million settlement from the Biden administration. In a ruling on Thursday, US

item.content:encoded:

Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to vacate $5 million settlement

A screen displays the Gemini signage, during the company's IPO at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York City, U.S., September 12, 2025. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : A federal judge in Manhattan has rejected a joint request by the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission and Gemini, a cryptocurrency exchange founded by twin brothers Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, to undo a $5 million settlement from the Biden administration.  In a ruling on Thursday, US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein said the agency and Gemini Trust Co had not met the standards required to set aside the settlement, which resolved a lawsuit over statements Gemini made during the agency's review of a proposed bitcoin futures contract. The CFTC and a lawyer for Gemini did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The CFTC sued Gemini in 2022, alleging the company made false or misleading statements during the agency's review of the proposed futures product. The January 2025 settlement came at the end of Democratic President Joe Biden’s administration and shortly before a trial.

Republican President Donald Trump’s administration has taken a friendlier, narrower approach to crypto sector enforcement. The commodities agency and Gemini in May jointly asked Hellerstein, appointed by Democratic President Bill Clinton, to wipe out the settlement and court order. They said in a filing that the agency’s complaint, lodged in 2022, would not have been filed under new enforcement policy priorities and standards under Trump. The court filing said regulators should not have accused Gemini of making false statements in connection with its bitcoin futures business. The CFTC and Gemini said the CFTC had "resorted to inappropriate tactics" to bring a lawsuit. Gemini agreed not to receive a refund on the $5 million penalty if the settlement were vacated. Hellerstein said Gemini had litigated against the CFTC for more than three years before voluntarily agreeing to settle and that the agency's current view of the case does not require vacating the settlement. The Winklevoss twins became widely known after accusing Mark Zuckerberg of stealing their idea for Facebook, a dispute that ended with a 2008 settlement that included cash and company stock.
