item.title: 仏独、自動車排出規制緩和で合意 英国に条件付き優遇措置
item.description:
Philip Blenkinsop
[ブリュッセル １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Philip Blenkinsop

[ブリュッセル　１６日　ロイター] - フランス、ドイツ両政府は１６日、自動車の二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）排出規制を緩和するとともに、英国に対して条件付きで優遇措置を認めることで合意したと発表した。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）欧州委員会は昨年、２０３５年までに自動車のＣＯ２排出量を２１年比で９０％削減するよう提案。自動車メーカーは低炭素鋼や代替燃料を使用することで残りの排出量を相殺し、１００％削減とする必要があるとしていた。両政府による合意では、相殺措置を必要とせず、ドイツの自動車メーカーの意向に沿った枠組みとなった。ＥＵで発効するには、他の加盟国や欧州議会の同意が必要となる。

公共調達や入札、補助金制度を通じて購入される製品に関し、現地調達要件や低炭素要件を導入するＥＵの提案に関しては、自動車部門での「欧州製」としてＥＵ加盟２７カ国に加え、２０年１月１日時点でＥＵ単一市場に参加していたパートナー国を含めるとした。２０年末にＥＵを離脱した英国が対象となる可能性がある。これまでフランスは、ＥＵ内で製造されたものに限定すべきだと主張。一方、ドイツを含めた他のＥＵ加盟国は、自動車サプライチェーン（供給網）で密接につながる国や自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）締結国なども対象とすべきだとしていた。

英首相府の関係者は、「欧州製」の対象となれれば、英自動車業界にとって朗報だと述べた。ただ、英国が適用を受けるにはＥＵと同等の措置を講じることが必要になるとみられる。

item.title: US strikes one-year deal to fund maternal and newborn health donations in poorest countries
item.description: The US government has struck a deal to continue supplying some of the world's poorest nations with free life-saving medication and equipment for mothers, infants and young children, after months of uncertainty and challenges with supply.
item.dc:creator: Ammu Kannampilly, Jennifer Rigby, Victoire Mukenge
item.content:encoded: The US government has struck a deal to continue supplying some of the world's poorest nations with free life-saving medication and equipment for mothers, infants and young children, after [USN:L6N40L0RM TEXT:"months of uncertainty"] and challenges with supply. The UN children's agency UNICEF will now procure these items, a State department spokesperson told Reuters by email, without giving details of the arrangement. UNICEF said the agreement is worth $25 million and will last for one year. That sum represents only a small part of the aid affected by the Trump administration's cuts and dismantling of the US Agency for International Development (USAID). But it means that some of the world's most vulnerable nations will not face another abrupt disruption to supplies they relied on while they work on new health aid deals with the US. Nine former US aid officials, NGOs and government officials told Reuters that this had been a real concern because the deal the now-defunct USAID had with its contractor was due to run out last month. SHORTAGES The agreement covers the procurement and delivery of maternal and child health supplies, as well as some nutrition supplies, to at least 15 countries previously covered, including Democratic Republic of Congo, Haiti and Mali, UNICEF said. It follows almost 18 months of disruption after Washington's move to freeze and then scale back [USN:L2N3PI0VN TEXT:"many US aid programmes"] as part of its "America First Global Health Strategy". In countries such as Congo, shortages due to the disruption have already been showing up on the ground. At the Nyangezi General Hospital in eastern Congo, health workers said they had run out of supplies of life-saving medications including oxytocin to prevent and treat post-partum haemorrhage and amoxicillin, an antibiotic for paediatric use and during childbirth. "It was a donation we received (previously) from USAID, and at the moment, there is none," midwife Alice Bulambo told Reuters. The main government-run warehouse in the area has faced stockouts for over a year, said Olivier Kabarati Amani, chief medical officer for Nyangezi health zone. As a result, facilities are forced to buy medicines at market prices. Over the last six months, "the cost of care has doubled, if not tripled," Amani said, at a time when the healthcare system in eastern Congo is [USN:L6N45L142 TEXT:"already struggling"] with Ebola. The US State Department said it "has prioritized ensuring all life-saving commodities have continued to be made reliably available." TRANSITION Maternal and newborn health items amounted to less than 1% of the more than $5 billion spent by the USAID Global Health Supply Chain program between 2016 and 2023, according to the most recently available annual report. The spending was channelled through private contractor Chemonics. Reuters [USN:L6N40L0RM TEXT:"first reported"] on plans to close this programme, which also managed the donation and delivery of supplies to tackle malaria and HIV, in April, with aid officials warning that the September 30 shutdown could cause shortages. The plans to close the Chemonics supply chain are part of the broader US global health strategy, which aims to move countries towards self-reliance alongside scaled-back US support and reduced reliance on contractors. The US has instead signed more than 30 bilateral deals on health aid with recipient countries, including Congo, which require co-financing from the countries and are worth billions of dollars in total. But the details of the deals are still being worked out and it had been unclear what would fill the gap in the ordering procedure in the meantime. While many nations were already moving towards taking over their maternal and child health needs, lead times for orders can be a year or more, five former USAID officials said. The Congolese government aims to take over by next year, but has struggled with the recent uncertainty, said Polydor Kabila, coordinator of the universal healthcare programme in the president’s office. Alongside the UNICEF deal, the US authorities have extended the deadline for Chemonics deliveries of some key malaria and HIV items, the State Department spokesperson told Reuters. The US has also signed a deal with the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria to allow countries to order new US-funded HIV and malaria supplies through the Fund's order platform. In a statement, UNICEF said it would work with the US to "keep health and nutrition supplies moving so more children receive life-saving care," adding that no orders have yet been placed but are expected shortly.

item.title: Empleados Meta dicen que cuentas de Lula se vieron limitadas durante la elección: Folha
item.description: Empleados de Meta reconocieron en comunicaciones internas que las cuentas de Instagram del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva se vieron afectadas negativamente por las restricciones impuestas durante las elecciones de Brasil, informó el viernes el periódico "Folha de S.Paulo", citando mensajes a los que tuvo acceso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Empleados de Meta reconocieron en comunicaciones internas que las cuentas de Instagram del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva se vieron afectadas negativamente por las restricciones impuestas durante las elecciones de Brasil, informó el viernes el periódico "Folha de S.Paulo", citando mensajes a los que tuvo acceso. Según el informe, los mensajes también reconocían que la plataforma recomendaba el perfil del candidato opositor, el senador Flávio Bolsonaro, así como su canal de WhatsApp. Meta dijo que los problemas técnicos mencionados en el artículo ya eran de dominio público y que las conversaciones a las que se hacía referencia eran únicamente sobre la gravedad de los problemas, y no una injerencia política. "Cualquier insinuación de que Meta favorece a una de las partes es falsa", añadió en un comunicado de la empresa. Lula se enfrentará a Bolsonaro en un balotaje el 25 de octubre, tras el resultado, mejor de lo esperado, obtenido por el senador en la primera vuelta celebrada a principios de este mes. El equipo de Lula afirmó a principios de esta semana que presentaría una denuncia ante la Organización de los Estados Americanos alegando que Meta, propietaria de Instagram, WhatsApp y Facebook, manipuló las redes sociales durante las elecciones de Brasil. Según el partido de Lula, algunas de sus publicaciones aparecieron sin botón para compartir, sufrieron una reducción de su alcance y presentaban historias que impedían las reacciones y el intercambio, además de aparecer sin audio o reproducirse a velocidad acelerada. Un magistrado del máximo tribunal electoral de Brasil ordenó el jueves a la empresa que no limitara injustificadamente el alcance del contenido político relacionado con ambos candidatos hasta el final de la campaña de la segunda vuelta. La resolución también estipulaba que Meta AI, el chatbot de inteligencia artificial de la empresa, no debe favorecer a ninguno de los candidatos a la hora de generar contenido relacionado con las elecciones.

item.title: Chinese online retailer Temu agrees to data privacy restrictions to settle Texas lawsuit, documents say
item.description: Chinese online retailer Temu has agreed to settle data privacy claims raised by Texas and will restrict how it handles personal data from shoppers in the state, according to documents made public Friday.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: Chinese online retailer Temu has agreed to settle data privacy claims raised by Texas and will restrict how it handles personal data from shoppers in the state, according to documents made public Friday. Temu faces several lawsuits from US states concerned that the company unlawfully harvests US user data that could be accessed by the Chinese government. Texas is the first to resolve those claims. It is also the first time the company has agreed to keep personal data on US servers and restrict when it can be sent to China, Texas officials said. Temu also agreed to conduct annual independent product safety testing to identify products containing dangerous chemicals and materials. Temu must remove any products found to contain dangerous materials, terminate the seller and its affiliated stores, notify affected Texas consumers, and issue full refunds. Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton said the settlement also requires Temu "to implement rigorous new product audits and safety standards to protect consumers from dangerous materials in products, including clothing and children’s items." He added it will prevent Temu from collecting and using Americans' data. Temu had more than 82.4 million active users in the United States as of September 2023, Paxton's office said. Temu will pay $3 million to the state as part of the settlement and Texas said failure to abide by various data security provisions would result in a potential $8 million penalty each year a violation occurs. Several states sued Temu in the wake of reports alleging Temu and parent company PDD Holdings < PDD.O > used invasive mechanisms in their apps. Temu, which did not immediately respond to a request for comment, denied wrongdoing in the settlement documents, and will also be required to hire a third party cybersecurity auditor to examine the app’s code for malware and spyware, one of the main concerns that spurred Texas to sue in February. Under the terms of the settlement, Temu agreed to send only data necessary to fulfilling a transaction, such as shipping addresses, to China. Texas alleged that Temu used code that allows an inappropriate level of access to users’ devices. Temu has denied the allegations.

item.title: Analysis:SpaceX's spectrum deal still leaves it far from rivaling telecom giants
item.description: Oct 16 : SpaceX called its recent multibillion-dollar purchase of US airwaves a critical step towards building a mobile network, but constructing a true rival to major American carriers will require a terrestrial network and likely years of work and billions more.Starlink became a money maker by offering inte

FAST

Oct 16 : SpaceX called its recent multibillion-dollar purchase of US airwaves a critical step towards building a mobile network, but constructing a true rival to major American carriers will require a terrestrial network and likely years of work and billions more. Starlink became a money maker by offering internet service in rural and sparsely populated areas, where it faced little competition, as well as changing to easy-to-set-up home packages at a competitive price. Mobile will be harder. Cities are particularly tough places for mobile telephony and are technologically challenging for mobile-to-satellite connections. The rocket and satellite company will likely need to invest heavily in ground infrastructure, customer service, handset subsidies and promotions — costly parts of the wireless business in which AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile already have extensive operations.

Building a network would cost more than $80 billion, according to TD Cowen, and add to SpaceX's capital demands as it pours money into its Starship rocket program, AI infrastructure, and Terafab chip factory. "It's just hard to imagine that this is all going to get done within a decade," said Julie Zhu, a research analyst at MoffettNathanson. "In the decade or so leading up to 2023, the big three spent about $650 billion in capex to build in networks that ostensibly were already finished." Most phones have small antennas and limited transmitting power that make reliable satellite connections more challenging because satellites orbit hundreds of kilometers above Earth, much farther away than cell towers. "There are too many pitfalls for satellite to be the only source of data," said Anshel Sag, principal analyst at Moor Insights & Strategy. SPACEX PUBLISHES HYBRID SPACE-TERRESTRIAL PLAN SpaceX has called the latest deal, in which it acquired 800 MHz spectrum licenses from Grain at a price a source pegged at nearly $8 billion, a "critical next step" for the nascent Starlink Mobile to provide high-speed mobile service. "Starlink Mobile will deploy a flexible architecture combining our satellite-to-mobile constellation in space with an advanced terrestrial deployment that can seamlessly connect devices everywhere," including "indoors, outdoors, in cellular dead zones, and everywhere in between", SpaceX said, announcing the purchase. SpaceX has received regulatory authorization for up to 15,000 Starlink Mobile satellites and plans to deploy traditional terrestrial infrastructure such as antennas on towers and rooftops — a hybrid approach rather than pure satellite-to-phone — it laid out in a regulatory filing made public last week. In a Starlink Mobile system, satellites could connect directly to mobile phones and indirectly by relaying signals through ground infrastructure. This is similar to the technology of a partnership between Starlink and T-Mobile, which provides the terrestrial network while Starlink supplies the satellite connectivity that fills in where there are no towers. That is a T-Mobile-branded service. SpaceX in theory could strike a deal with one of the big three companies to use its ground infrastructure, what is known as a mobile virtual network operator, or MVNO, arrangement. However, SpaceX "appear to be going after a more build-your-own approach to a terrestrial network since nobody will offer them wholesale MVNO," Sag said. SpaceX would need several times more spectrum to match the holdings of the three big mobile companies, although current spectrum might be enough to start. "It is for a company with zero mobile subscribers, plenty of runway, and a robust device/equipment ecosystem," TD Cowen said. Would-be rivals dismissed the idea that the effort was an imminent threat. T-Mobile Chief Technology Officer John Saw said SpaceX's spectrum would not be enough to match the capacity and performance of established mobile networks, while Katie Magnotta, Verizon's associate vice president of corporate communications, said, "A company can have billions of dollars of spectrum, but if they do not have the network to use it, it's just empty airwaves."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Wall Street cae con fuerza presionado por las dudas sobre la IA y el alza del petróleo
item.description: Wall Street cerró el viernes con fuertes caídas, con CoreWeave, Broadcom y otras acciones tecnológicas relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial sometidas a una nueva presión, mientras que el repunte de los precios del petróleo inquietó a los operadores antes del fin de semana.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: Wall Street cerró el viernes con fuertes caídas, con CoreWeave, Broadcom y otras acciones tecnológicas relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial sometidas a una nueva presión, mientras que el repunte de los precios del petróleo inquietó a los operadores antes del fin de semana. El Nasdaq amplió las pérdidas de principios de semana, arrastrado por la preocupación de que las empresas de infraestructura de IA, muy endeudadas, no puedan obtener ganancias a tiempo para saldar sus deudas, sobre todo ante la previsión de que aumenten los costos financieros. CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , respaldada por Nvidia, se desplomó, lo que se sumó a las pérdidas recientes. Los bonos del operador de centros de datos sufrieron una corriente vendedora esta semana, lo que elevó sus rendimientos a más del 15%. Broadcom (AVGO.O) también cayó y el índice de chips PHLX (.SOX) registró su octava jornada consecutiva de descensos. Los inversores también estuvieron pendientes de cómo los precios del petróleo subían más de un 3% debido a la preocupación por el suministro de Oriente Medio. "Hay cierto temor en el mercado", dijo Rob Haworth, estratega senior de inversiones de U.S. Bank Wealth Management. "Los altos precios del petróleo, en particular, tienden a presionar el múltiplo precio/beneficio de las acciones, por lo que creo que los inversores optan por mostrarse cautos antes del fin de semana en lugar de asumir más riesgos". A las preocupaciones por el financiamiento de la IA se suma que algunos inversores actuales y potenciales de Anthropic están considerando una valoración más baja para la empresa en su próxima salida a bolsa, según un reporte de Reuters, que citó a personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 85,44 puntos, o un 1,10%, a 7.658,62 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) retrocedió 572,99 puntos, o un 2,15%, a 26.137,85. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 189,01 puntos, o un 0,36%, a 51.990,05 unidades. La temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre sigue la próxima semana con las publicaciones de Tesla (TSLA.O) , Meta Platforms (META.O) y Procter & Gamble (PG.N) . Según datos de LSEG, los analistas prevén, en promedio, que las ganancias trimestrales se disparen más de un 30%, impulsadas por las grandes compañías relacionadas con la IA.

item.title: Retorno de bonos a EEUU a 10 años anotan su mayor caída semanal en más de un año
item.description: La sesión volátil del viernes llevó a los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años a registrar su mayor caída semanal en más de un año, mientras los inversores analizan los últimos datos económicos y los operadores apuestan a que la Reserva Federal no volverá a subir las tasas de interés hasta diciembre.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: La sesión volátil del viernes llevó a los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años a registrar su mayor caída semanal en más de un año, mientras los inversores analizan los últimos datos económicos y los operadores apuestan a que la Reserva Federal no volverá a subir las tasas de interés hasta diciembre. Tras una semana tumultuosa en la que el retorno de las notas a 10 años osciló entre un máximo del 5,329% el miércoles y un mínimo del 5,037% el jueves, el bono cotizó con altibajos el viernes. Aun así, los rendimientos a 10 años sufrieron su mayor baja semanal desde la semana que finalizó el 1 de agosto de 2025. "Hay un sinfín de corrientes subyacentes contrapuestas en el mercado de bonos del Tesoro que empujan y tiran del extremo largo de la curva de rendimientos en diferentes direcciones, lo que genera bastante volatilidad intradía", afirmó Michael Reynolds, vicepresidente de estrategia de inversión de Glenmede. Señaló una "huida hacia la seguridad" debido a la volatilidad en los mercados de renta variable, impulsada por la preocupación por las empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) muy endeudadas, y una tendencia creciente de los inversores a buscar oportunidades en bonos desde que los rendimientos alcanzaron a principios de este mes sus máximos en décadas. En cuanto a los datos, los precios de exportación de Estados Unidos subieron un 2,2% en septiembre, frente a expectativas de consenso que apuntaban a un 1%, y al 1,2% de agosto, cifra que se revisó al alza desde el 0,6% previo. Los precios de importación aumentaron más de lo esperado, impulsados por el encarecimiento de los productos energéticos y otros bienes, lo que constituye una prueba más de las crecientes presiones inflacionarias derivadas del conflicto en Oriente Medio, que ya dura varios meses. La producción industrial de septiembre subió un 0,7%, frente a las expectativas de los economistas de un 0,4%. Aunque los inversores apostaban cada vez más por que la Fed haría una pausa en sus subidas de tasas de interés, algunos se sintieron decepcionados por la falta de orientación por parte de su presidente, Kevin Warsh. Warsh afirmó que no "prejuzga" las decisiones sobre las tasas de interés. Sin embargo, en su intervención en las reuniones anuales de 2026 del FMI y el Banco Mundial en Bangkok, señaló que, con la subida de tasas de septiembre, la Fed "dejó muy claro que garantizaríamos la estabilidad de los precios y que eliminamos una dosis de política monetaria expansiva". Los operadores reforzaron sus apuestas a que la Fed mantendrá las tasas sin cambios en su reunión del 27 al 28 de octubre, descontando una probabilidad del 83% de que haya una pausa, y de un 88% de un alza en diciembre, según datos de LSEG. El retorno de los bonos referenciales a 10 años se mantuvo en un 5,087%, tras haber subido a un 5,1334%. El rendimiento de las notas a 30 años avanzó 0,5 puntos básicos, al 5,433%, luego de empinarse al 5,464%. Los papeles a dos años , que suele moverse en línea con las expectativas de tasas de la Fed, rentaron 3,2 puntos básicos menos, o un 4,783%. * Un indicador muy seguido de la curva de rendimiento, que mide la diferencia entre el retorno de la deuda a dos y 10 años y es considerada un indicador de las expectativas económicas , operaba en 36,6 pb.

item.title: Meta employees said Lula's accounts were hindered during Brazil election, Folha reports
item.description: Meta employees acknowledged in internal communications that the Instagram accounts of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva were hindered by restrictions during the country's election, newspaper Folha de S.Paulo reported on Friday, citing messages it reviewed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) employees acknowledged in internal communications that the Instagram accounts of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva were hindered by restrictions during the country's election, newspaper Folha de S.Paulo reported on Friday, citing messages it reviewed. The messages also acknowledged the platform recommended the profile of challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, as well as his WhatsApp channel, according to the report. Meta said the technical issues cited in the report were already public and the conversations it referenced related solely to the severity of the issues, not political interference. "Any suggestion that Meta favors one side is false," it added in a statement Lula will face Bolsonaro in a runoff on October 25, following a stronger-than-expected performance by the senator in the [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"first-round vote"] earlier this month Lula's camp said earlier this week it would file a complaint before the Organization of American States alleging that Meta, which owns Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook, manipulated social media during Brazil's election According to Lula's party, some of his posts appeared without a share button, suffered reduced reach, and had stories that prevented reactions and sharing, in addition to appearing without audio or playing at accelerated speed A justice at Brazil's top electoral court ordered the company on Thursday not to unjustifiably limit the reach of political content related to both candidates through the end of the runoff campaign The ruling also stipulated that Meta AI, the company's artificial intelligence chatbot, must not favor either candidate when generating election-related content

item.title: 米財務省、ロシア政府系ファンドに軽油取引の決済円滑化要請＝ドミトリエフ特使
item.description:
Vladimir Soldatkin Olesya Astakhova
[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Vladimir Soldatkin　Olesya Astakhova

[モスクワ　１６日　ロイター] - ロシアの政府系投資ファンド、ロシア直接投資基金（ＲＤＩＦ）を率いるドミトリエフ大統領特別代表は１６日、トランプ米大統領とロシアのプーチン大統領が合意したロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）取引を巡り、米財務省から決済の円滑化を要請されたと明らかにした。また米ロ両国が、ロシアの小型原子力発電所を活用したデータセンター建設など、新たな共同事業について協議していることも明らかにした。

ドミトリエフ氏はロシアの首都モスクワで開かれたエネルギー関連会議で、米財務省がＲＤＩＦに対し「決済の円滑化と実務的な問題の解決」を求めたとした上で、「ＲＤＩＦは全ての決済が効率的に行われ、資金が本来の受取先に確実に届くよう取り組む」と述べた。

同時に「制裁措置が幾重にも積み重なっているため、誰もが混乱しており、打開策を見いだすのが難しくなっている」と指摘。「制裁解除の方法を巡る検討はすでに始まっており、米国は現在、まさにその作業を進めている」と語った。

ドミトリエフ氏はまた、「ロシアと米国のデータセンター分野での共同事業についても協議している。小型原子力発電所の活用も含まれる」と述べた。詳細には触れなかった。

ウクライナは今月、ロシアのＩＴ大手ヤンデックスと銀行・テクノロジー大手ズベルバンクのデータセンターを攻撃した。ウクライナはこれを、自国施設へのロシア軍の攻撃に対する報復としている。

米ロ協議で主要な役割を担うドミトリエフ氏は、鉱物資源やエネルギーを含む幅広い分野で野心的な合意を模索してきた。米政府はこれまで、こうした合意をウクライナ和平と結び付ける姿勢を示しており、ロシア政府は不満を表明してきた。和平合意は依然見通せない状況だ。

ただ、ドミトリエフ氏はこの状況が変わりつつあるとの楽観的な見方を提示。「当然ながら進展は難しい。各方面から広範な抵抗がある。それでもディーゼルの事例が示すように、他の重要な取り組みを近く発表できると考えている。氷は実際に解け始めている」と語った。

ドミトリエフ氏はこれまでにも、ロシア産ディーゼル供給を巡る米ロ合意は、両国間の一段の経済協力に道を開く可能性があるとし、今回のディーゼルを巡る合意が米ロ間の他の経済協力のモデルになり得るとの見方を示している。

また、故リンゼー・グラム上院議員が提案した対ロシア制裁法案（グラム法）について、ロシアと米国の投資協力を阻害するものと非難。「ロシアと米国の共同事業を明らかに阻害するほか、両国がエネルギー市場の安定化や世界市場で果たす役割が妨げられる」と語った。

トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼルを供給することで合意したと発表。燃料価格の引き下げを狙った措置で、米政権はウクライナ戦争の戦費となるロシアの収入源を断つことを目的に科していたロシア産燃料に対する制裁を一時解除した。

item.title: US tells election officials to be on guard against AI-powered tricks ahead of midterms
item.description: The FBI and the US cyber defense agency CISA are urging election officials -- and the American public -- to be on guard against AI-powered tricks ahead of next month's midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The FBI and the US cyber defense agency CISA are urging election officials -- and the American public -- to be on guard against AI-powered tricks ahead of next month's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. Here are more details: An alert issued Friday by CISA and the FBI says that hackers may try to disrupt the midterm elections using bogus text messages and emails aimed at stealing passwords or other sensitive data. The alert says that "election officials, candidates, and their political organizations are attractive targets to malicious cyber criminals." The alert says that "super intelligence," a Trump-approved term for AI, is allowing hackers to sharpen their rogue emails and texts to make them look and sound more convincing.

item.title: アングル：ＡＩ投資ブームが資金争奪戦招く、中銀は高金利長期化警戒
item.description:
Francesco Canepa Leika Kihara Rae Wee
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 人工知...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：ＡＩ投資ブームが資金争奪戦招く、中銀は高金利長期化警戒 0:04 配信

2026年10月16日、タイのバンコクで撮影。REUTERS/Athit Perawongmetha

Francesco Canepa　Leika Kihara　Rae Wee

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）の投資ブームが世界的な資金争奪戦を引き起こしている。各国の中央銀行幹部は、金利が高止まりし、政府は長年の財政大盤振る舞いの後に緊縮を迫られる未来を思い描かざるを得なくなっている。

半導体やデータセンターから電力網や通信網に至るまで、政府や企業はＡＩに直接・間接に関連するプロジェクトに資金をつぎ込んでおり、世界経済に勢いを与えると同時に、金利を押し上げている。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行の年次総会のためタイの首都バンコクに集結した主要国の中央銀行幹部は、ＡＩが約束する生産性向上よりはるかに先行して投資が殺到しているため、ブームは新たなインフレ圧力と金融リスクをも生み出していると指摘した。

ウォーシュ米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）議長は「中央銀行の立場であれば、これをショックとして認識せざるを得ない」と指摘。「供給サイドに影響が及ぶ前に、経済の需要サイドを明らかに直撃している」と認めた。

ウォーシュ氏は、米国は幅広い「投資の急増」の恩恵を受けていると説明する一方、最終的な勝者が依然不透明な、技術や投資家、企業、政策当局者のせめぎ合いの中で、移行過程は「非常に荒れたものになる」可能性があると警告した。

主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の他の中銀幹部数人は、ＡＩ投資を支える明るい収益見通しがわずかに見直されるだけでも、今週のアジア市場で起きたハイテク株の売りが示したように、市場に深刻な動揺を引き起こしかねないと述べた。

＜雲に隠れた星＞

今回の議論は、世界的な貯蓄過剰と低過ぎるインフレが続くことを政策当局者が懸念していた、２００８年の金融危機後の数年間からの顕著な転換を示している。

今や中銀幹部は逆の問題、すなわち資本に対する需要が過剰であるという問題を一層強く認識している。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのカザークス・ラトビア中銀総裁はロイターに「世界的な資金争奪戦が起きている。ＡＩ投資は資金コストを押し上げる主要因の一つだ」と語った。

米国から日本、ドイツに至るまで、政府が防衛、産業政策、エネルギー関連の事業で巨額の借り入れを行っていることが、こうした圧力を増幅させている。

中銀幹部にとっての含意は、経済を安定的に維持するために必要な金利水準、いわゆる自然利子率（ｒスター）が上昇している可能性があるということだ。

南アフリカ準備銀行（中央銀行）のクガニャゴ総裁は「現時点でｒスターを算出する上での問題は、星が雲に覆われており、しかもその雲が非常に厚いことだ」と述べ、「ｒスターがより高いことは分かっているが、どれほど高いのかは分からない」と語った。

中立金利が上昇すれば、同じ金利水準でも従来考えられていたほど景気抑制的ではないことを意味する。

イングランド銀行（中央銀行）のピル主席エコノミストは「平均すれば、金利はもう少し高くなるかもしれない」と述べた。

日銀はすでに、ＡＩ関連需要を最近の利上げの背景要因の一つとして挙げており、投資主導の物価圧力がより広範で持続的になっていると主張している。

エコノミストはイングランド銀が１１月５日の次回金融政策委員会で利上げすると予想している。ＥＣＢとＦＲＢは９月に利上げを実施し、両行とも１２月に再度利上げを行うと市場は織り込んでいる。

＜もはや安い資金はない＞

構造的に金利が上昇する見通しは、金利がゼロ近辺で推移していた期間に多額の債務を積み上げた政府にとって課題となる。国債利回りは世界的に上昇しており、ここ数週間で一部は世界金融危機前以来の水準に達した。

ユーロ圏、とりわけ巨額の債務を抱えるフランスが特にそのあおりを受けやすいとみられている。

ＡＩ主導の投資増加の多くは米国で発生しており、日本やアジアの他地域でもある程度生じている。一方、欧州側で明確な勝者と言える企業は、オランダの半導体製造装置大手ＡＳＭＬやドイツのシーメンスなど数社にとどまる。

さらにユーロ圏はイランやウクライナでの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇に直面しており、これがインフレ圧力を増大させ、財政を圧迫している。

ＥＣＢのラガルド総裁はバンコクでのＣＮＮのイベントで「一部の国がより大きな影響を受ける特別な事情がある。フランスがその一例だ」と述べ、「それについては、第一の、そして最大の解決策はフランス国内にあり、財政政策に関わるものだ」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か 最終更新: 10/17(土) 0:04 ロイター

FAST

Oct 16 : French media and digital regulator Arcom has opened an investigation into Mym, a France-based platform offering subscription-based content including adult material, over suspected breaches of the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA). Arcom said on Friday it had sent Mym a formal request for information on October 14, giving the platform 15 days to respond or face sanctions, after a preliminary review raised concerns about child protection and service transparency. Mym did not immediately respond to a request for comment. • Arcom suspects Mym may have breached the DSA in two areas: protecting minors, including age-verification measures, and transparency requirements, citing incomplete terms of use and insufficient information about its recommendation systems

item.title: Monedas cierran mixtas en medio de retroceso global del dólar
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina tuvieron un desempeño dispar el viernes, en medio de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales luego de que las expectativas sobre un posible nuevo aumento de alzas de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal se han ido diluyendo en los últimos días.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina tuvieron un desempeño dispar el viernes, en medio de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales luego de que las expectativas sobre un posible nuevo aumento de alzas de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal se han ido diluyendo en los últimos días. * El dólar bajó el viernes, y registró su primera caída semanal en más de un mes frente al euro y al yen, en medio de preocupaciones por una ola de ventas en las bolsas impulsada por la inteligencia artificial. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde ante una canasta de seis grandes divisas, retrocedía alrededor de un 0,3%. * El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, se mostró optimista el viernes respecto a la solidez de la economía estadounidense y se sorprendió de lo bien que las economías mundiales han "aguantado" en medio de las recientes crisis geopolíticas, a pesar de la política monetaria más restrictiva adoptada para combatir la inflación. * En tanto, un reporte indicó que los precios de las importaciones en Estados Unidos subieron más de lo previsto en septiembre, lo que constituye una prueba más del aumento de las presiones inflacionarias a medida que persiste el conflicto en Oriente Medio. * El peso mexicano cotizaba cerca del cierre en 18,5023 unidades por dólar, con una baja del 0,56%, pero apuntaba a frenar una racha de cinco semanas de pérdidas. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un 1,94%, a 68.979,11 unidades para cerrar una semana de ganancias acumuladas, mientras los inversionistas evaluaban los primeros resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre en Estados Unidos. * El real brasileño se apreció un 0,30%, a 5,0730 unidades por dólar y acumuló un alza semanal del 1,75%, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo avanzó un 0,41%, a 205.156,74 puntos y acumuló un avance del 3,97% durante la semana. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista se depreció un 0,3% a 1.518 unidades por dólar para la venta, con el habitual seguimiento de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA). * La entidad monetaria sumó 68 millones de dólares este viernes y acumuló 642 millones para sus reservas a lo largo de esta semana. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) cedió un 0,35%, mientras que los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil perdieron el 0,1% y cayeron un 0,9% en promedio durante la semana. * El peso chileno , bajó un 0,13%, a 983,80/984,10 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , cerró estable en a 10.970,29 puntos. * El peso colombiano cerró con baja de un 0,09% a 3.173 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSIC COLCAP (.COLCAP) , perdió un 0,55% a 2.566,28 puntos. * [USN:S0N429026 TEXT:"Subir la tasa de interés"] podría no tener el mismo impacto sobre la inflación en Colombia que el que tendría en otro momento, pero sí estaría afectando las decisiones de inversión en el país, consideró el viernes la codirectora del Banco Central, Laura Moisá, en una entrevista con Reuters. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,47% a 3,4370/3,4390 unidades por dólar pero subió un 0,2% en la semana. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) mejoraba un 0,12% a 1.583,47 puntos.

item.title: 米製造業生産、9月は0.3％増 第3四半期は中東紛争背景に失速
item.description: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１６日発表した９月の製造業生産指数は前月比０．３％増と...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米製造業生産、9月は0.3％増　第3四半期は中東紛争背景に失速 10/16 23:38 配信

米アーカンソー州ブライスビルにあるヌコールの製鉄工場。2025年3月撮影。REUTERS/Karen Pulfer Focht

[ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１６日発表した９月の製造業生産指数は前月比０．３％増と、エコノミスト予想と一致した。前月から持ち直したものの、第３・四半期全体では、サプライチェーン（供給網）の混乱やエネルギー価格の高騰を招いている中東紛争を背景に、勢いは大きく失速した。

８月分は当初の０．３％減から０．２％減に上方改定された。

９月は前年同月比では１．１％上昇した。第３・四半期は年率換算で０．７％増と、第２・四半期の５．６％増から大幅に鈍化した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの構築や、底堅い国内需要に対応するための企業の在庫積み増しが製造業の活動を下支えする一方、エネルギー価格の上昇やカナダとの貿易戦争、借り入れコストの上昇が生産の下振れリスクとなっている。

シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「ＡＩの強い需要が企業の設備投資を押し上げているが、その投資の多くは輸入によるものであり、国内生産はそれほど強くないことを示唆している」と述べた。

９月の耐久財の生産は０．１％の小幅増となった。第一次金属、機械、電気機器・家電製品・部品の生産増が押し上げ要因となった。

一方、自動車・同部品の生産は３．０％減少した。耐久財の生産は第３・四半期に３．８％増加した。ＡＩ関連投資ブームを背景に、半導体および関連電子部品の生産が２８．４％急増したことが一因。

非耐久財の生産は、前月比０．４％増加。ただ、第３・四半期は１．６％減少した。

鉱業生産は０．２％増加、第３・四半期は年率５．０％の伸びを示した。公益事業生産は冷房需要を背景に３．５％急伸した。第３・四半期は１４．８％のペースで増加した。

鉱工業生産全体では０．７％増加。前月は０．１％増だった。前年同月比では２．２％増加。第３・四半期は２．８％増と、第２・四半期の４．８％増から伸びが鈍化した。

鉱工業部門の設備稼働率は７６．９％と、前月の７６．４％から上昇した。１９７２─２０２５年の平均を２．５％ポイント下回っている。

製造業の稼働率は前月の７５．８％から７５．９％に小幅上昇したものの、長期平均を２．３％ポイント下回った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/17(土) 1:26 ロイター

item.title: Activos financieros argentinos cierran semana en baja
item.description: La plaza financiera de Argentina cerró en terreno negativo y con signos de prudencia el viernes, ante la cautela de inversores institucionales debido a recientes vaivenes del riesgo país y datos macroeconómicos domésticos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera de Argentina cerró en terreno negativo y con signos de prudencia el viernes, ante la cautela de inversores institucionales debido a recientes vaivenes del riesgo país y datos macroeconómicos domésticos. Por su parte, en el contexto externo, las recientes declaraciones del presidente de la Reserva Federal (Fed), Kevin Warsh, generan incertidumbre sobre el devenir de las tasas de interés con impacto en las plazas emergentes. "Warsh pasó por Bangkok y evitó el único tema que el mercado quería escuchar. En una charla con Kristalina Georgieva (...) el presidente de la Fed no dedicó una sola línea a la política monetaria ni al panorama económico estadounidense", dijo Portfolio Personal Inversiones (PPI). Y añadió que "no se adelantó a decir que van a hacer en la reunión de octubre (...). Más allá de esto, el mercado espera con un 85% de probabilidad que mantengan inalterado el rango de tasas en octubre y lo suban recién en diciembre". En el ámbito local, el índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires cedió un 0,35% al cierre, mientras que los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil perdieron el 0,1% y cayeron un 0,9% en promedio durante la semana. El riesgo país argentino se afirmaba en la zona de 641 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), luego de oscilar recientemente entre un máximo de 650 unidades a inicios de mes y uno mínimo de 577 registrado la semana pasada como efecto del triunfo electoral de la derecha en Brasil. "Lo mejor que podemos esperar este año (del riesgo país es) que pueda terminar por debajo de los 500 puntos básicos", expresó en una entrevista el economista y docente Martín Polo. Remarcó que pese a los datos negativos de la actividad económica de julio, es "muy probable que los indicadores vengan un poco mejor y el Gobierno se ilusione", lo que podría ayudar a traer inversiones y mejorar el nivel del riesgo país. La tercera economía de América Latina viene de registrar en julio una contracción en su actividad económica (EMAE) de 1,4% interanual y de 2,9% en su medición desestacionalizada. Para agosto, economistas prevén que el EMAE arroje un resultado positivo. El dato oficial de la actividad económica se conocerá a mediados de la semana próxima. El peso argentino mayorista se depreció un 0,3% a 1.518 por dólar para la venta, con el habitual seguimiento de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA). La entidad monetaria sumó 68 millones de dólares este viernes y acumuló 642 millones para sus reservas a lo largo de esta semana corta por el feriado del lunes pasado.

item.title: US solicits exchange of up to 17 million barrels of oil from strategic reserve
item.description: The United States has issued a request for proposal for an exchange of up to 17 million barrels of crude oil from the nation's Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the Department of Energy said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States has issued a request for proposal for an exchange of up to 17 million barrels of crude oil from the nation's Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the Department of Energy said on Friday. The exchange would be part of a global deal [USN:FWN3ZY1GJ TEXT:"the US struck in March"] to try to control fuel prices impacted by the Iran war . Washington agreed then to loan 172 million barrels of oil from the SPR as part of a wider deal with about 30 countries in the International Energy Agency to release 400 million barrels from reserves around the world. The US has released about 132.5 million barrels from the SPR since the US-Iran war began. The latest 17 million barrel round would be a portion of the pending 40 million barrels of oil that would be the last batch of the release. The Department of Energy had offered the 40 million barrels in June, but revealed later that month that companies agreed to borrow only about 500,000 barrels. The government offered those barrels again in late September. While the Department of Energy has not published the awards from that round, Friday's announcement implies that around 23 million barrels were awarded in the September round, research and consultancy Energy Aspects wrote in a note.

FAST

LONDON, Oct 16 : A surge in octopus numbers in British waters due to unusually warm seas is presenting fishermen with an interesting new catch — albeit one that's devouring one of their usual staples. The value of British octopus exports rose to £12.8 million ($17 million) last year from £164,000 a year earlier, with demand driven largely by buyers in France and Spain, according to industry body Seafish. However, researchers found that more than half of UK fishermen had reported negative impacts from octopus predation on crab, lobster and scallop stocks, with catches in some fisheries falling by 30 per cent to 50 per cent and losses to affected fisheries exceeding £10 million in 2025. Fishermen, regulators and scientists met this week at a government-hosted conference after British octopus landings jumped nearly 1,500 per cent from 2021, rising to more than 3,700 metric tons from an annual average of about 220 tons.

The government said on Friday the conference would help inform future decisions on managing the emerging fishery, a challenge Spain and Australia have also faced in recent years. Scientists studying the phenomenon say the current bloom is the largest seen off southwest Britain in at least 75 years. "The sudden arrival of this fast-growing, short-lived and highly predatory species into British waters upends a lot of our established knowledge and expectations about our coastal ecosystems," said Mike Cohen, CEO of the National Federation of Fishermen's Organisations. "They are both a threat and an opportunity for fishermen, and a massive challenge for fisheries management." OCTOPUSES FEASTING ON BRITISH SHELLFISH Anjali Goswami, chief scientific adviser in the government's environment department, said the rise in octopuses in British waters was "a stark reminder of how quickly our marine ecosystem can change". While some fishermen have found a valuable new catch almost overnight, others say the predators are damaging shellfish stocks that underpin long-established fisheries. Researchers have also reported widespread breeding of common octopus in British waters during the current event. They say warmer waters, together with ocean currents and winds that may have carried octopus larvae north from France and the Channel Islands, are among the most likely contributors to the surge. Research published this year found that every major octopus bloom recorded in the region over the past 125 years had coincided with unusually warm sea conditions. ($1 = 0.7497 pounds)

item.title: トランプ氏、イラン核関連地下施設への攻撃の可能性示す
item.description: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -  トランプ米大統領は、イランの核兵器保有を確実に阻止するため、同国の核開発計画に関連する施設「ピックアックス・マウンテン」を米国が攻撃する必要があるかもしれないと述べた。１５日夜、ニューズマックスとのインタビューに応じた。

トランプ氏は、米国はイランが決して核兵器を保有しないようにしたいとし、「保有すれば使用するだろうからだ」と語った。

「彼らの核関連施設は、数百万トンもの山の岩盤の下に埋まっている。今、われわれはピックアックス・マウンテンに目を向けている。そこを攻撃する必要があるかもしれない。攻撃を試みる。速やかに破壊する」と述べた。

トランプ氏は、対イラン戦争で、核兵器を使用することはないとも明言。「核兵器は使わない。その必要はない」と語った。

イランへの米地上部隊投入は検討していないとも改めて述べた。

大規模爆風爆弾「ＧＢＵ―４３／Ｂ」（ＭＯＡＢ）をイランのエネルギーインフラや核施設に対して使用することを承認したかどうかは明らかにしなかった。ただ、ＭＯＡＢは核爆弾ではないと述べた。

ピックアックス・マウンテンは、イランの主要核施設の一つに近い地下深くに設けられた、強固に防護された施設。

WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : A new government task force on AI used its inaugural meeting to set up protocols, a risk study and various committees, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNBC on Friday, a day after gathering in Washington.  Clayton leads the group, which Trump has dubbed the Super Intelligence Task Force to use his preferred term for artificial intelligence, along with Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor, Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson and Defense Department technology lead Emil Michael.      Here are some of his comments: • "We set out a protocol and a path for making sure that those accords are implemented and that we're in dialogue with the frontier labs."

item.title: 米9月輸入物価、前年比8.1％上昇 4年超ぶりの大幅な伸び
item.description: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１６日に発表した９月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月輸入物価、前年比8.1％上昇　4年超ぶりの大幅な伸び 10/16 22:39 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチ港で７月撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

[ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１６日に発表した９月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。前年比では８．１％上昇と、２０２２年７月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。中東紛争が続く中、インフレ圧力が高まっていることを改めて示唆した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月比０．８％上昇だった。８月分は当初発表の０．７％上昇から０．５％上昇に下方改定された。関税は輸入物価指数から除かれている。

９月の輸入燃料価格は前月比４．８％上昇し、８月の０．２％下落から反発した。輸入食品価格は横ばい。８月は０．６％下落していた。

輸入資本財価格は０．９％上昇。投資ブームを背景としたコンピューター、周辺機器、半導体の価格上昇に押し上げられた。

自動車を除く輸入消費財の価格は０．４％上昇した。耐久消費財が０．７％上昇したことがけん引した。輸入自動車・部品・エンジンの価格は０．３％上昇した。

食品とエネルギーを除くコア輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、伸びは前月から横ばいとなった。前年比では６．２％上昇した。

中国からの輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、２１年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前年比では３．１％上昇。日本、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、メキシコ、カナダからの輸入価格も上昇した。

輸入航空旅客運賃は１２．６％急騰した。７月と８月は下落していた。

今週発表された消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）はいずれも大幅な伸びを示しており、エコノミストの間ではインフレがエネルギー部門を超えて波及しているとの見方が強まっている。米国・イラン戦争が長期化する中、サプライチェーン（供給網）は混乱し、原油価格は高止まりしている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「米国人はあらゆる面でインフレの脅威に直面しており、ほんの数カ月前までは安かった同じ商品に少し多く払わなければならない状況にある」と指摘。「２５年１月に第２次トランプ政権の経済政策が始動する前には、輸入物価のインフレは見られなかったが、今年はいたるところでインフレが起きている」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米国の「軽油ショック」、消費者の身の回りで着実に進行 アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 最終更新: 10/17(土) 0:12 ロイター

item.description: BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The artificial intelligence boom is setting off a global race for money, forcing central bankers to contemplate a future in which interest rates stay higher and governments need to tighten their belts after an era of largesse.From silicon chips and data centres to power grids and telecoms ne

Central bankers eye higher rates as AI boom fuels scramble for cash

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The artificial intelligence boom is setting off a global race for money, forcing central bankers to contemplate a future in which interest rates stay higher and governments need to tighten their belts after an era of largesse. From silicon chips and data centres to power grids and telecoms networks, governments and companies are pouring money into projects tied directly or indirectly to AI, adding fuel to the global economy and pushing up borrowing costs. Central bankers from the world's largest economies gathering in Bangkok said the boom was also creating fresh inflation pressures and financial risks, because the investment is arriving long before the productivity gains AI promises. "If you're a central banker...you've got to recognise this as a shock," Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok. "It's obviously hitting the demand side of the economy before it's going to hit the supply side."

Warsh, who said the US was benefiting from a broadening "surge of investment", warned the transition could be "very bumpy" as investors, companies and policymakers grappled with a technology whose ultimate winners remain unclear. Several of his colleagues from the G20 group of large economies also in the Thai capital said it would only take a slight reassessment of the rosy earnings prospects underpinning AI investments to cause profound market ructions, as a selloff in Asian tech stocks showed this week. STARS BEHIND THE CLOUDS The debate marks a striking shift from the years following the 2008 financial crisis, when policymakers worried about excess global savings and inflation that was persistently too low. Now central bankers increasingly see the opposite problem: too much demand for capital. "There is a global fight for money," ECB policymaker Martins Kazaks told Reuters. "Investment in AI is one of the key factors driving up the cost of money." That pressure is being amplified by governments from the United States to Japan and Germany borrowing heavily for defence, industrial policy and energy projects. For central bankers, the implication is that the level of interest rates needed to keep economies on an even keel, known as R-star, may be rising. "The problem at the moment in calculating the R-star is that the stars are covered by the clouds, and the clouds are so thick," South African Reserve Bank Governor Lesetja Kganyago said. "We know that R-star is higher, but we do not know how high." A higher neutral rate means the same level of interest rate is less restrictive than previously thought. "Maybe rates, on average, will be that little bit higher," said Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill. The Bank of Japan has already cited AI-related demand as a factor behind its recent rate increases, arguing that investment-driven price pressures have become broader and more persistent. Economists expect the Bank of England to raise rates at its next meeting on November 5. The ECB and Fed raised rates in September, and markets have priced in another move by them both in December.  NO MORE CHEAP MONEY The prospect of structurally higher borrowing costs poses a challenge for governments that built up large debts during years when interest rates hovered near zero. Sovereign bond yields have risen across the world, and in recent weeks some have reached levels not seen since before the global financial crisis. The euro zone, and notably debt-laden France, was seen as particularly exposed. Much of the AI-driven investment surge is taking place in the United States and, to a lesser extent, Japan and other parts of Asia, with ASML and Siemens among the few clear European winners. Meanwhile, the bloc faces higher energy costs from wars in Iran and Ukraine, compounding inflation pressures and squeezing public finances. "There are particular circumstances that lead to some countries being more affected, France being a case in point," ECB President Christine Lagarde said at a CNN event in Bangkok. "And for that one, the primary and first solution lies at home in France. And it has to do with fiscal policies."

(Additional reporting by David Milliken and David Lawder; Editing by John Mair and)

Source: Reuters

IMF chief urges cooperation on AI and war risks, as US hails economic momentum

Kristalina Georgieva, Managing Director of IMF, speaks to Ceda Ogada, Secretary of IMF at the Annual Meetings Plenary for the IMF/World Bank 2026 Annual Meetings at Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok, Thailand, October 16, 2026. REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The head of the IMF on Friday appealed to global leaders to cooperate in the face of multiple economic risks, including rapid advances in AI and a prolonged war in the Middle East, as Washington hailed what it sees as US-led economic momentum. Their contrasting views echoed throughout this year's annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok, as finance officials and central bankers from around the world took stock of a global economy rocked by high inflation and rising interest rates that have kept growth sluggish and increased inequality. The IMF on Tuesday slightly raised its global growth forecast to 3.1 per cent in 2026, well below the historical average, as it flagged significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential ending of the AI investment boom, growing debt levels and the ongoing Middle East conflict. Absent the US-Israeli-led war against Iran and Tehran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz that triggered a massive global energy shock, the IMF has said it would have expected AI to have fueled much stronger growth.

On Friday, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said the sheer speed of technological change added to the long list of challenges, including disruptions to the global trading system, high food and energy prices and lingering wars, all of which threatened to widen the gulf between advanced economies and the world's poor. Bond markets, she said, were clearly sensing the risks, with US, German and Japanese 10-year sovereign yields reaching their highest levels in decades. "The need of the hour is for urgent and practical international cooperation," Georgieva, the first IMF chief from an emerging market economy, said at a plenary session on Friday. She told a subsequent panel that she spent sleepless nights worrying about how to regulate AI and ensure that poorer countries weren't left behind by its breakneck-speed development. US Treasury Under Secretary Erin Browne, in a call with reporters, pushed back against those warnings, hailing record highs on the US stock market, strong US economic output and improvements in Japan's economy. "The IMF needs to take a more balanced approach to assessing the global economic outlook," she said, adding: "The global economy has demonstrated significant resilience with strong US growth helping to support broader economic and financial stability." She said that the Fund should give equal consideration to "opportunities for positive economic shocks, particularly those driven by American innovation and super intelligence, energy abundance, and productivity-enhancing reforms." US President Donald Trump's policies on tax, trade, energy and deregulation were paving the way for stronger investment, higher productivity and durable economic growth, she said. AI JITTERS HIT STOCKS Emerging market stocks have been volatile in recent weeks, roiled by expectations of higher US interest rates that have sent borrowing costs sharply higher. Major markets have also been hit by the growing concerns over the AI investment cycle. South Korean shares posted their biggest weekly fall in 18 years as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom, while Japan's stock market lost 5.4 per cent over the week. Eli Remolona, governor of the Philippines' Bangko Sentral ng Pilipanas, said in an IMF panel discussion earlier in the week that he was concerned Asia had not learned the lessons of its destructive financial crisis in the late 1990s. Before the Asian financial crisis broke out in 1997, economies drew huge capital inflows that prompted the World Bank to describe it as the "East Asian miracle," Remolona said. "Investment poured into Asia, and then you had the crisis because it wasn't really a miracle. I think we have to remind ourselves about that. We have to guard against that kind of crisis," he said on Wednesday. "We have not really been making a lot of effort looking at that kind of crisis." Illustrating the vulnerability to sudden shifts, Indonesian stocks fell 11.6 per cent on Friday, their steepest one-day fall in 28 years, after global index provider MSCI said the Indonesian market was no longer worthy of "emerging market" status. Officials at the IMF and World Bank this week said they are seeing elevated demand for grant and loan programs. IMF strategy chief Christian Mummsen said the IMF's low-interest lending to low-income countries had quadrupled since the COVID pandemic, and demand was expected to remain strong. About 60 per cent of the IMF's financing since COVID had gone to low-income countries, he said.  Developing countries are increasingly outspoken about their concerns. Barbados this week joined a group of countries calling for the creation of an international panel to address inequality, citing geopolitical tensions, climate change and rapid technological advances that could further divide wealthy and poorer nations.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Panzani, Cerealis in talks to create €1.8 billion European food group
item.description: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday. The proposed deal reflects a broader push for consolidation in Europe's food sector as manufacturers seek greater scale to cope with rising costs, strengthen their bargaining power with retailers and expand across regional markets. The deal would create a European food group with about €1 billion in annual revenue and nearly 1,800 employees, the companies said Panzani, which is controlled by private equity firm CVC, generated €620 million of revenue in 2025. Cerealis, controlled by its founding families and Belgian investment company Sofina (SOF.BR) , reported revenue of €400 million Panzani and Cerealis would remain headquartered in Lyon and Porto respectively and retain operational autonomy The merged group would be owned by Cerealis' existing shareholders, including the Moreira da Silva and Silva Domingues families and Sofina, alongside CVC Capital Partners, which would keep a minority stake Cerealis' Executive Vice Chairman Pedro Moreira da Silva would lead the combined group, while Panzani CEO Albert Mathieu would oversee Panzani and its Central European operations. Cerealis CEO Paula Meireles would manage its Iberian and international private-label business ($1 = 0.8887 euros)

item.title: 基調物価2％の判断、10月会合でしっかり議論 経済は見通し通り＝日銀総裁
item.description:
Takahiko Wada Takaya Yamaguchi
［１６日 ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
基調物価2％の判断、10月会合でしっかり議論　経済は見通し通り＝日銀総裁 10/16 21:50 配信

2026年9月18日、日本銀行の政策決定会合終了後に記者会見する植田和男総裁。ロイター／キム・ギョンフン

Takahiko Wada　Takaya Yamaguchi

［１６日　ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。

９月の決定会合以降の経済のデータは「おおむね見通し通りに動いている」とし、今回の出張で様々な当局者と意見交換をしたが、自身の見立てと「矛盾するような重要な情報がもたらされたとは考えていない」と話した。

主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議などへの出席のため訪問したタイ・バンコクで会見した。

植田総裁は基調物価が２％に迫る中、「（基調物価が）これ以上上がることは容認できず、その定着を政策の大きな目標にする」と説明した。植田総裁は９月の決定会合後の会見で「政策の局面が変化した」と言及していた。

インフレ圧力について、中東情勢と人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の高まりを特に注視してきたが、日銀と各国当局者の間で見解に「大きな食い違いはないとの印象を持った」と述べた。ＡＩ関連の需要動向について、日銀よりも「やや心持ちしっかりしているとみている当局者が少し多いと思った」とも話した。日銀は１０月会合で「経済・物価情勢の展望」（展望リポート）を議論する。

植田総裁は、基調物価が２％に近づき、金融環境が緩和的な中で、経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて「政策金利を引き上げて緩和度合いを調整していく」と述べた。政策調整のタイミングやペースについては、中東情勢やＡＩ関連の需要動向、為替相場の動きを見ながら、見通しの確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくと改めて説明した。

中立金利については「はっきりとこの辺にあると申し上げられるような材料があるわけではない」とし、これまでの利上げの累積的な効果を見極めながら判断していきたいと述べた。

８月３１日から９月１日に米国・アッシュビルでＧ２０や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の財務相・中銀総裁会議が開かれた際、植田総裁はベセント米財務長官と会談した。この日の会見では、アッシュビルでの会談以降は「コミュニケーションは特に取っていない」と述べた。ウォーシュ米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）議長とは「様々な意見交換をした」としたが、具体的な内容は明らかにしなかった。

植田総裁とともに会見に臨んだ三村淳財務官は、足もとの金融市場の状況について「今に限らず、いつにあっても常に金融市場の状況をしっかりと注視し、決しておかしなリスクが顕在化しないようにしっかりと取り組む」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に 最終更新: 10/16(金) 21:59 ロイター

item.description: AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems. An Ahold spokes

Supermarket operator Ahold's websites, app remain offline 5 days after cyber incident

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems.  An Ahold spokesperson said the parent company cannot comment about the situation at its individual chains. Its US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, are collectively one of the largest food retailers in the United States. Physical stores remain open.  Ahold's Albert Heijn chain, the Netherlands' largest, has been gradually recovering from the shutdown that began October 11, disrupting its distribution centres and leading to empty produce shelves. Albert Heijn does not expect online delivery to resume before Sunday. The Netherlands' Justice Minister David van Weel called on the company on Friday to file a criminal complaint over the incident, which Ahold has avoided describing as a hack, saying in a statement that no "customer, associate and partner data was taken".

"I understand that in the heat of the moment, a company like this is concerned with preventing damage to its systems and is not immediately looking outward," the minister told Dutch press agency ANP. "I think that we're in calmer waters now and the time has come to take this step." The Ahold spokesperson said the company could not respond to the politician's remarks and pointed to its most recent statement on October 14, in which it said the company was working with relevant internal teams and external cybersecurity experts and engaging with the appropriate authorities and other stakeholders as necessary. That statement said that because Ahold's investigation is ongoing, it could not share details about what happened in order not to undermine its own security or interfere with its response.

item.title: ロシア無人機、ウクライナ各地攻撃 3人死亡
item.description: [キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局によると、１６日未明に各地でロシアの無人機（ドローン）攻撃があり、少なくとも３人が死亡した。商業施設２カ所が攻撃を受けたほか、北西部では電力網への攻撃で約３７万人が停電の影響を受けた。

ハルキウ州知事によると、東部ハルキウ市の３地区への攻撃で２人が死亡、１２人が負傷した。同氏は当初、死者を３人としていた。

ポーランドと国境を接する北西部ヴォルィーニ 州では、食品加工施設への攻撃で１人が死亡、８人が負傷した。

当局によると、前線に近い北部スムイ市と、ヴォルィーニ州に隣接するリウネ州でも、それぞれ少なくとも１カ所の商業施設が攻撃を受けた。

FAST

Tokyo, Oct 16 : The next phase of Japanese corporate reform took center stage at the Sohn Conference in Tokyo, as hedge fund managers highlighted investment opportunities ranging from a financial conglomerate's capital allocation strategy to an X-ray scattering firm's AI solutions. At the inaugural Sohn Conference in Japan, which invited 14 funds to pitch their top investment ideas, more than half of the investors favored the theme of corporate reform. Daisuke Nakayama, a portfolio manager at Hong Kong-headquartered Polymer Capital, picked Orix Corporation, a financial services firm, saying the change in management marks "a big turning point" for the company's transformation into a global investment firm. "The new leadership has a greater focus on capital allocation and ROE," Nakayama said, adding the firm is now using overseas capital, including from Qatar Investment Authority, to bid for companies.

The number of activist campaigns in Japan hit a record last year, according to brokerage Jefferies, after years of pressure from regulators and the Tokyo Stock Exchange on companies to improve shareholder returns and invest in growth.  BEYOND DIVIDENDS AND BUYBACKS Fund managers said that the next chapter is not just about companies increasing dividends and buybacks but also about focusing on those deploying capital to expand businesses and drive long-term growth. One example is Rigaku, an X-ray equipment supplier pivoting to semiconductor metrology, measuring and inspecting chips.  New York-based Indus Capital Partners said it had invested in the company and had engaged with the firm to sell a stake to a US semiconductor firm to drive revenue.  As semiconductor companies are going into vertical structures to scale, X-ray is needed to detect defects deeper in the 3D chips, said Byron Gill, managing partner at Indus. Rigaku might be one of the few companies that "has the key to unlocking scale for the semiconductor industry in the middle of a super cycle", he added, forecasting a 100 per cent rise in its valuation by 2029. REFORM THEME DOMINATES The corporate reform theme still has a long way to run, market participants said.  "Japan changes slowly, but once the change starts, it does not reverse," said Naohide Une, partner and CEO at Investment Lab, a former senior managing director at Japan Post Bank. He picked Japanese chemical company Ube Corporation for its corporate reform efforts. In a separate Q&A session, Seth Fischer, founder of activist Oasis Management, said his fund may substantially increase its stake in Japanese electric motor maker Nidec. AI AS A BACK-OFFICE TAILWIND AI was another key investment theme.  Investment firms Ruane Cunniff and Japan Catalyst picked software companies Money Forward and OBIC Business Consultants, respectively.  They argued that back-office software operators are AI winners rather than losers, as clients require accuracy. And these businesses are helping Japan overcome labor tightness, they said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Why is the battle for Yemen's Taiz so important?
item.description: The city of Taiz is rapidly emerging as the most important battlefront in Yemen's reignited civil war, pitting the Iran-allied Houthis against the internationally recognised government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition.
item.dc:creator: Angus Mcdowall
item.content:encoded: The city of Taiz is rapidly emerging as the most important battlefront in Yemen's [USN:L6N45S0PX TEXT:"reignited civil war"], pitting the Iran-allied [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"Houthis"] against the internationally recognised government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition. Houthi forces have [USN:L1N45Z0S1 TEXT:"encircled Taiz"] in recent weeks by cutting its main road south to Aden, causing widespread displacement and worsening a humanitarian crisis. Here's what you need to know: WHY IS TAIZ SO IMPORTANT? Any Houthi victory in Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, would mark one of the biggest turning points in the country's long civil war, which resumed this summer after a four-year truce. Taiz city has an estimated population of almost 600,000, said Katja Juric, Aden-based head of programmes for the International Organization for Migration (IOM). Government sources said 80,000 had fled in the latest fighting. Taiz has been on the frontline between the Houthis and the government since the first days of the conflict that started in early 2015 and has long been seen as a bastion of opposition to the Iran-allied group. It is the last major urban stronghold of anti-Houthi forces in the southern highland area of Yemen: the rugged hills above both Aden, where the internationally recognised government is based, and the flat coastal plain around the [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb"] Strait. A Houthi takeover of Taiz would make it much harder for government forces to maintain their counterattack around Bab el-Mandeb and keep the Houthis at arm's length from Aden. It would also mean a resounding symbolic defeat for the government and the military coalition of Saudi-backed Yemeni forces fighting the Houthis. WHAT'S THE MILITARY SITUATION AROUND TAIZ? For years the city has sat at the tip of a government salient stretching north into Houthi territory. The Houthis held areas to the north, east and west of Taiz, while government forces had the city and its immediate surroundings including Jebel Sabar, the high mountain rising above it to the south. As fighting in Yemen resumed in recent weeks, the Houthis began making advances to cut off Taiz by seizing territory to the south of Jebel Sabar along the road to Aden, which snakes about 200 km (125 miles) through rugged hills where fighting is slow and difficult. Sections of the road are now under Houthi control, including at the towns of al-Turbah and Mudiriyat al-Misrakh, leaving Taiz encircled since early October, with the Houthis sometimes shelling government positions in and around the city. Government forces, backed by airstrikes from the Saudi-led coalition, are trying to drive the Houthis back from their recent gains and reopen the road, but were still losing ground around Taiz rather than recapturing territory in mid-October. WHY IS TAIZ A STRONGHOLD OF OPPOSITION TO THE HOUTHIS? Taiz had a long history of difficult ties with rulers from north Yemen and was a hotbed of the 2011 Arab Spring uprisings that toppled veteran former president Ali Abdullah Saleh. While the Houthis adhere to the Zaydi school of Shi'ite Islam, Taiz is predominantly Sunni Muslim. Saleh and the Houthis joined forces to seize the capital, Sanaa, in 2014, derailing a political transition that arose out of the Arab Spring and had led to a proposal for a federal, democratic state. In early 2015, army units loyal to Saleh seized positions in the city, leading to big protests there followed by armed clashes. Protesters accused Saleh and the Houthis of mounting a coup d'etat. Months of fierce fighting in and around the city followed, with the Houthis and Saleh's army units battling local fighters and army brigades from Yemen's now fragmented military that backed the government. Taiz citizens endured shelling, sniper fire and terrible shortages in a long siege before government forces eventually drove the Houthis and their allies from the city and re-established a land route to Aden. The fighting in the city lasted throughout 2015 and parts of 2016, and the siege ran for long stretches until 2017. WHAT IS THE HUMANITARIAN SITUATION IN TAIZ? The latest fighting has displaced at least 121,000 in Taiz province, according to the IOM, though many of these are from rural areas outside the city. Inside Taiz, residents have told Reuters about the shortages they now face of basic items and the huge increase in prices they see in the city markets since the Houthis cut the road to Aden. Aid agencies have reported widespread shortages of fuel, food, medicines and clean water. Wheat flour stocks in the city are nearly exhausted, the World Food Programme said in mid-October. The situation risks worsening existing health problems. The UN children's agency UNICEF recently found that one in three of the children it screened in Yemen was malnourished. Cholera, dengue and malaria are all present in Yemen too. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? Government forces backed by Saudi airstrikes are still trying to take back territory to reopen the road, but there is no guarantee they will succeed. The Houthis, who have [USN:L1N46209G TEXT:"upped their attacks"] on Saudi targets while showing themselves [USN:L6N4580DE TEXT:"better armed"] and organised than in earlier phases of the war, are meanwhile trying to cement their siege of Taiz and move closer towards the city. That might lead to a prolonged siege of the kind that Taiz experienced in the earlier phase of the war. It's also possible the Houthis might try to take the city. Local opposition means resistance could be fierce and any such attempt could cause a long, bloody battle.

item.title: 欧州、債務持続性へ成長加速と赤字削減を＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Jan Strupczewski
［バンコク １６日 ロイター］ - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日、欧州各国が公的債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州、債務持続性へ成長加速と赤字削減を＝ＩＭＦ 10/16 20:59 配信

国際通貨基金（IMF）のロゴ、ワシントンの本部で2024年撮影 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/File Photo

Jan Strupczewski

［バンコク　１６日　ロイター］ - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日、欧州各国が公的債務を持続可能な水準に維持するには成長を加速させるか、借り入れを減らす必要があるとし、「何もしないという選択肢はない」と警告した。

ＩＭＦは１３日、ユーロ圏の経済成長率について、４月時点と同じく２０２６年が１．１％、２７年は１．２％と予想した。インフレ率は、２６年が３．１％、２７年が２．８％、２８年が２．２％になると予測した。

ＩＭＦは「債務の持続可能性を保つには、欧州諸国の約４分の３で、成長を高めて歳出圧力を緩和する構造改革と、中期的に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比で平均約３．５％に相当する財政赤字削減策を組み合わせる必要がある」と指摘した。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）全加盟国が欧州委員会と合意しなければならない「中期財政・構造計画」で予定されている財政再建規模はＧＤＰ比で平均約２％にとどまり、一部の国で必要とされる水準を下回っているという。

「スタッフの基本予測は、大半の国で財政再建が計画を下回ることを示しており、想定されている再建規模でさえ達成が困難となる恐れがある」と指摘。

「欧州諸国の約４分の１は、公的債務を持続可能にするためにＧＤＰ比で５％超の財政再建が必要となる。これは過去に実行可能と証明された水準を上回っており、政府活動の範囲を見直し、不足分を補うために民間部門の役割を拡大する以外に選択肢はない」と分析した。

欧州委が５月に発表した予測によると、ＥＵ全体の債務の対ＧＤＰ比率は、２５年末時点の８２．８％から２６年に８４．２％、２７年末までには８５．３％へ上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏の比率も２５年の８８．７％から２６年に９０．２％に上昇し、２７年には９１．２％に達すると予測されている。

ＩＭＦ欧州局長のマテウシュ・シュチュレク氏はロイターに対し、「高齢化、国防費増額、エネルギー移行など、欧州の大半の国が直面している長期的な歳出課題を勘案すると、政策変更がなければ欧州の平均的な経済において公的債務は大幅に増加し、現在の水準の最大２倍に達する可能性がある」と述べ、中欧の高成長国の一部では、この債務拡大のペースがさらに速くなる可能性があるとした。

「持続可能性の定義が（債務の）増大を止めて安定化させられるかどうかであるなら、財政面での対応と再建が不可欠だ」とし、「より早く動く方が常に対処費用は少なくて済む。着手が遅れるほど調整は難しくなる」と語った。

ＩＭＦは欧州の成長加速に向けた最大の障害は低水準の生産性だと指摘し、各国政府に対してＥＵ域内市場の障壁を取り除き、技術革新（イノベーション）や事業拡大への投資を行うよう求めた。

「一定の改革に向けた取り組みが進められているものの、未完成のＥＵ単一市場と各国の障壁が、企業の事業調整や規模拡大、より大きな市場へのアクセスを困難にしている」とした。

また、化石燃料から再生可能エネルギーへの移行を継続し、重要鉱物を含む世界的なサプライチェーン（供給網）の多様化を進めるよう呼びかけた。これらは全てＥＵが既に取り組んでいる政策方針となる。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：欧州熱波、マクロ経済面からの市場注目ポイント コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:59 ロイター

item.title: 仏借り入れコスト上昇、長期化なら財政健全化圧力高まる＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Jan Strupczewski
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のシュチュレク欧州局長はフ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏借り入れコスト上昇、長期化なら財政健全化圧力高まる＝ＩＭＦ 10/16 20:55 配信

シュチュレクＩＭＦ欧州局長、１４日撮影 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

Jan Strupczewski

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のシュチュレク欧州局長はフランスの借り入れコストが上がっていることについて、短期的には対処できるとの見方を示した。ただ上昇が続けば２０２７年予算だけでなく、信頼性のある中期的な財政健全化計画の策定を求める圧力が強まると指摘した。

シュチュレク氏はバンコクで開かれているＩＭＦ年次総会の合間にロイターの取材に応じた。現時点では仏国債市場はまだ秩序立った動きを保っているとの認識を示した。

「（市場には）流動性があり、（国債の）償還期間もかなり長く、投資家層も多様だ。銀行の流動性が高いことも支えになっている。このため短期的な債務リスクには十分対応できる」と語った。

一方、「利回りの高止まりが長引けば、財政とコスト抑制への圧力が強まる。財政の不均衡是正が急務であることを改めて認識させる。まずは２７年予算から着手すべきで、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の財政ルールに沿って遅滞なく承認される必要がある」と述べた。

フランスは２６年の財政赤字を国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５．４％と見込む。２７年は５．０％への引き下げを目標としている。ＥＵの法令を順守するには、２９年までに赤字をＧＤＰ比３％未満に抑える必要がある。

シュチュレク氏は「それは確かに必要だ。市場の動きは、われわれにもフランスの政策当局者にも、その必要性を改めて認識させている」とし「市場のシグナルには政策を変える力がある。過去に何度も見てきた。ある意味では、債券市場から現実を突き付けられることで、財政調整のあり方が変わり、調整が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:55 ロイター

item.title: Strategy faces MSCI ouster under new rules, billions in passive holdings at risk
item.description: Michael Saylor's Strategy faces potential removal from MSCI's global equity indexes under new rules adopted on Thursday, threatening billions of dollars in passive investment in the bitcoin buyer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR.O) faces potential removal from MSCI's global equity indexes under new rules adopted on Thursday, threatening billions of dollars in passive investment in the bitcoin buyer. Shares of Strategy, the world's biggest corporate bitcoin holder and a constituent of the MSCI USA and MSCI World indexes, fell 4.2% on Friday. MSCI said on Thursday non-operating companies will be ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes from the close of November 30, as part of its November index review. It will publish the final list of affected companies on November 11. The decision follows a review MSCI [USN:L1N3X907U TEXT:"began "]a year ago, when it proposed excluding digital asset treasury companies on the grounds that they resemble investment funds, which are already barred from its indexes. MSCI [USN:L4N3Y80MJ TEXT:"deferred "]that plan in January and opened a broader review on all non-operating companies. MSCI defines non-operating companies as investment funds and business development companies, and other companies whose finances make them look like one. Strategy and Japan's Metaplanet (3350.T) are on MSCI's list of potential deletions. SharpLink (SBET.O) and several other crypto treasury companies are on a watchlist for possible removal. The changes are aimed at expanding MSCI’s exclusions for passive investment vehicles, with companies required to meet financial tests on their operating assets to remain eligible. Index inclusion matters to companies such as Strategy because passive funds and other investors tracking benchmarks are required to hold their shares. Strategy did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The company warned last year that an exclusion would result in $2.8 billion of its stock being [USN:L6N3XP0XN TEXT:"liquidated "]and would "chill" the industry. Strategy, which pioneered the model of raising money through stock and debt sales to buy bitcoin, had a market value of about $64.3 billion on Friday. Its shares were down 4.8% in 2026.

item.title: トヨタ、30年までに全車種をＳＤＶに 年1000万台の新車に独自ソフト搭載
item.description: [東京 １６日 ロイター] - トヨタ自動車は、２０３０年までに世界で販売する全５０車種を「ソフトウエア定義車両（Ｓ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トヨタ、30年までに全車種をＳＤＶに　年1000万台の新車に独自ソフト搭載 10/16 20:20 配信

トヨタ自動車の「ＲＡＶ４」。２０２５年５月、東京で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Manami Yamada）

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - トヨタ自動車は、２０３０年までに世界で販売する全５０車種を「ソフトウエア定義車両（ＳＤＶ）」にする。独自のソフトウェアプラットフォーム（基盤）「Ａｒｅｎｅ（アリーン）」を新車に順次搭載する。ＳＤＶで先行する中国や米国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーを追撃し、年間１０００万台規模の新車販売に加え、売った後もソフトの更新などを通じて課金するビジネスモデルを強化する。

同社広報によると、中嶋裕樹副社長が先週、アリーンの導入計画をベルギーのブリュッセルで投資家に説明。３５年にはトヨタ車以外にも展開し、提携先など他社の車両にアリーンを供給する考えも明らかにしたという。

トヨタは２５年に発売したスポーツ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）「ＲＡＶ４」で初めてアリーンを導入し、今後販売する新車に順次展開する方針を示唆していた。

ＳＤＶは、スマートフォンのように購入後も無線通信を通じてソフトを更新し、先進運転支援技術やエンタテイメントなど車の性能や機能を向上させる車で、米テスラや中国勢が先行している。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：サウジを揺さぶるフーシ派、攻撃力向上の背景は アングル：米国の「軽油ショック」、消費者の身の回りで着実に進行 コラム：トヨタ自動車、ＨＶ技術活用で再び成長軌道へ 焦点：トヨタの中国合弁2社に再編機運、市場縮小と競争激化で転換点 焦点：トヨタ社長、3年でなぜ交代　インフレが変えた時代の潮流 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:20 ロイター

item.title: TSX rises as oil stocks gain on Brent touching $110 a barrel
item.description: Canada's main stock index gained on Friday, boosted by oil stocks, while investors assessed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index gained on Friday, boosted by oil stocks, while investors assessed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) gained 0.11% to 36,176.55, touching its highest level since September 4. The index gained 1.44% in the week. Energy stocks (.SPTTEN) rose 2.8%. Brent touched $110 a barrel for the first time since May on worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further tighten supplies. South of the border, Wall Street ended sharply lower, with CoreWeave, Broadcom and other AI-related technology stocks under renewed pressure. In Canada, technology stocks <.SPTTTK> fell 3.5%, dragged down by a 5% fall in Shopify (SHOP.TO) and 7.7% decline in BlackBerry (BB.TO) . "It's (AI trade) probably affecting the TSX to a significantly lesser extent than it's affecting some of the US indices... there's a pretty big disparity between tech and everything else at the moment," said Josh Sheluk, CIO at Verecan Capital Management. "The TSX offers a pretty interesting diversifying investment relative to global stocks because it is a lot more heavily allocated and weighted towards not only energy but materials as well," Sheluk said. Macklem said Canada [USN:SPN46200A TEXT:"has not raised interest rates"] yet but the longer elevated energy prices go on "the harder that gets". The BoC is not expected to raise interest rates at its next monetary policy decision announcement on October 28, but money markets are pricing in a rate hike of 25 basis points in December, according to data compiled by LSEG. Data on the day showed that Canadian home sales [USN:L6N46119G TEXT:"extended their decline"] in September, after a drop in August, as higher mortgage rates and expectations of a rate hike weighed on demand.

BERLIN, Oct 16 : Germany is set to announce a cooperation agreement with US chipmaker Nvidia next week to expand the use of artificial intelligence in German industry, government sources said on Friday, adding the plan will involve partners beyond Nvidia and be a major contribution to industrial AI. Business daily Handelsblatt, which first reported on the plan, said the deal would support physical AI tools for training robots and self-driving vehicles and help develop powerful AI models for industrial use.
